lines.Ostron 人从中提取毒素，并将之用于狩猎。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人: Ostrons extract the toxin and apply it to their weapons when hunting animals. Source: Cut from Cuthol fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Cuthol in Plains of Eidolon pond hotspots at Night. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.Ostron 人将其煮成胶状，干燥后便成为一种强力的粘合剂。获取途径：通过希图斯: The Ostron boil these into a jelly which forms a strong adhesive when it dries. Source: Cut from Tralok fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Tralok in the Plains of Eidolon ocean during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.Ostron 用来烹饪和制药的材料。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从阴暗: An ingredient used in Ostron cooking and medicine. Source: Cut from Murkray fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Murkray in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots at any time of day using Murkray Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

lines.◆ Description: 和谐战胜憎恨。重击会立刻结算所有的异常状态效果伤害: ◆ Description: Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration. Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
lines.◆ Description: 在绝望的时刻，让歌声响彻战场。歌颂的刃片会扎入战场: ◆ Description: In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed. Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
lines.◆ Description: 当 Lavos 转化战场时，他的蛇鼓励着他。他使用: ◆ Description: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：AKBRONCO PRIME）同时使用这两: ◆ Description: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：AKSOMATI）月神步枪的强大威力被凝聚: ◆ Description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：BRATON PRIME）一把经典的奥罗金: ◆ Description: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：DARK SWORD）一把使用暗黑金属制作: ◆ Description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate Radiation Damage with attacks.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：DUAL CODA TORXICA）用这对: ◆ Description: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：DUAL KAMAS）两手各挥舞一把短柄战: ◆ Description: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：EDUN）雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。重击以投: ◆ Description: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：GAZAL MACHETE）每次用这把俯冲: ◆ Description: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of Corrosive Damage.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：GRIMOIRE）获取阿尔布雷希特·英择谛: ◆ Description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed Electricity Status.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：HEAT SWORD）其强力的刀刃能对敌人: ◆ Description: A strong blade capable of inflicting Slash Damage to its foes.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：KOHM）寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击: ◆ Description: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：KUVA KOHM）这把赤毒寇恩热能枪变体: ◆ Description: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：LENZ）从这把 Corpus 弓箭中射出: ◆ Description: Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：LESION）能造成严重伤害的一把武器。如: ◆ Description: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased Toxin Damage.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：MIRE）米尔感染之剑是一柄来自「大瘟疫」: ◆ Description: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals Toxin Damage on Ground Slam attacks.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：ONOS）阿尔布雷希特的虚空实验揭示了这把: ◆ Description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of Heat.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：OPTICOR）一旦这挺 Corpus 激: ◆ Description: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：SANCTI CASTANAS）这种能遥控: ◆ Description: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：SCOLIAC）这条脊椎节鞭是由一只令人生: ◆ Description: The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping Toxin Damage with attacks.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：SLAYTRA）屠煞是对传统 Grinee: ◆ Description: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of Slash Status Effects.
lines.◆ Description: （英文：SYNAPSE）由生化反应驱动，被感染的突: ◆ Description: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of Corrosive energy.

lines.◆ Note: （英文：CYNGAS）释放出致命般精准的爆发性混乱。: ◆ Note: Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR PRIME）使赫利俄斯 Pr: ◆ Note: Allows the Helios Prime to violently disassemble and turn itself into a deadly projectile.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR）赫利俄斯用自己身上的部件攻击: ◆ Note: Causes the Helios Sentinel to attack enemy targets using pieces of itself.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：DETH MACHINE RIFLE PRIME）死亡魔: ◆ Note: Signature default weapon of Dethcube Prime.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：DETH MACHINE RIFLE）死亡魔方标准武器: ◆ Note: Standard issue weaponry signature to Dethcube.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：DUAL DECURION）什长双枪是专门为了在真空的太: ◆ Note: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：FLUCTUS）一把能射出致命等离子波来击溃敌人的曲翼能: ◆ Note: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：GRATTLER）这把毁灭性的曲翼火炮能发射爆裂弹来击碎: ◆ Note: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：HELSTRUM）发射密集的微型导弹。: ◆ Note: Launches a swarm of micro-missiles.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：IMPERATOR VANDAL）这款为 Tenno 量: ◆ Note: The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：IMPERATOR）能在太空中开火的长射程步枪，凯旋将军: ◆ Note: A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：KASZAS）拿起这把曲翼镰刀，化身为死亡天使。: ◆ Note: Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：KNUX）为曲翼近距离作战所制的镓合金动力拳套。由恶名昭: ◆ Note: Gallium-alloy gauntlets for close-range Archwing combat. Designed by the infamous Tyl Regor.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：KUVA AYANGA）用这款全自动曲翼榴弹发射器的怒火: ◆ Note: Sweep aside hordes of enemies with flaming fury of this powerful, automatic, grenade launching archgun.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：KUVA GRATTLER）重新调配以获得最大杀伤力，赤: ◆ Note: Reconfigured for maximum lethality, the Kuva Grattler still shatters targets with explosive shells, but now reaches maximum fire-rate instantaneously.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：LACERTEN）猎犬近战攻击通过冲击和切割伤害进行毁灭: ◆ Note: Hound melee attacks devastate with Impact and Slash Damage.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：LARKSPUR PRIME）迎接混乱的到来吧。连锁攻击: ◆ Note: Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：LASER RIFLE）通过 Corpus 科技逆向工程: ◆ Note: A laser rifle developed by reverse-engineering Corpus technology.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：MANDONEL）辐光弩炮发射辐射伤害投射物。未完全充能: ◆ Note: Mandonel fires Radiation Damage projectiles. Partially charged shots release a spread and fully charged shots release a beam that dissolves into a radiation field. Projectiles that pass through the field are empowered.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：MULTRON）发射一连串炸弹飞镖，嵌入目标中并在短时间: ◆ Note: Launches a volley of bomb darts that embed themselves in targets, exploding a short time later.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：NAUTILUS PRIME）这位勇敢的水手使用冰凇 P: ◆ Note: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：ONORIX）这把激光刀刃的战斧能轻易突破船只的防御和保: ◆ Note: This laser bladed battle-axe easily hacks through a ship's defenses and the forces protecting it.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：PHAEDRA）借由这把菲德菈——月神最年长的姊妹——纵: ◆ Note: Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：PRISMA BURST LASER）点射一小束激光。: ◆ Note: Fires a small burst of lasers.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：PRISMA DUAL DECURIONS）比太空更冷酷: ◆ Note: Colder than space and less forgiving, Prisma crystals bring elite efficiency to the already sleek Dual Decurion. Requiring the lightest of touches to reload, these twin archguns prove that heavy weaponry can still possess elegance.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：PRISMA VERITUX）这把曲翼之剑包覆在棱晶之中: ◆ Note: A rare object of beauty, this Archwing sword has been sheathed in prisma crystal and baptized in the Void’s energy.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：STINGER）引灵守护的标准武器。发射毒素投射物，嵌入: ◆ Note: Standard issue weapon for Djinn Sentinel. Fires Toxin projectiles that embed into enemies and continuously deal damage for 3 seconds.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：SWEEPER PRIME）搬运者 PRIME的标准武器: ◆ Note: Standard issue weapon for Carrier Prime Sentinel. Fires shotgun rounds.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：SWEEPER）搬运者守护的标准武器，使用霰弹枪子弹。: ◆ Note: Standard issue weapon for Carrier Sentinel. Fires shotgun rounds.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：TAZICOR）释放出一阵静电，该静电可以在敌人之间跳跃: ◆ Note: Releases a burst of static electricity that can jump between foes, incapacitating them.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：VELOCITUS）当充能完成后，极速电磁步枪的磁化枪管: ◆ Note: When fully charged, the magnetized barrel of the Velocitus accelerates a metal slug to tremendous speeds, piercing hulls and obliterating armor.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：VERGLAS PRIME）鹦鹉螺 Prime 的标志性: ◆ Note: The icy signature weapon of Nautilus Prime.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：VERITUX）零重力的太空将这把大到难以想象的巨剑变成: ◆ Note: Weightless space turns this impossibly massive sword into an agile instrument of destruction.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：VULCAX）可蓄能发射出强力爆发的极热电浆。: ◆ Note: Charges up a powerful blast of ultra-heated plasma.
lines.◆ Note: （英文：VULKLOK）电气浮囊的标准狙击枪。: ◆ Note: Standard issue sniper rifle for Diriga.
lines.◆ Passive: Hildryn 的满护盾保险时间很长。在她的护盾耗尽后，她: ◆ Passive: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.
lines.◆ Passive: Mag 会吸引附近的物品，以便捡取。: ◆ Passive: Nearby items gravitate toward Mag for easy collection.
lines.◆ Passive: Sevagoth 死亡时，会化身成 Sevagoth 的幽: ◆ Passive: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.
lines.◆ Passive: Styanax 的暴击几率随着他的护盾量而提升，标枪武器可: ◆ Passive: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.
lines.◆ Passive: Voruna 从不孤军奋战。在任务中，长按技能可以召唤每匹: ◆ Passive: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf’s unique Passive power.
lines.◆ Passive: 在地面时无法被击倒。: ◆ Passive: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.
lines.◆ Passive: 在承受致命伤害后，Wukong 会自动使用他所掌握的其中一: ◆ Passive: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.
lines.◆ Passive: 在维度之间流动，Wisp 在空中时对敌人来说是隐形的。: ◆ Passive: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.
lines.◆ Passive: 展开翅膀以进行一次额外的跳跃和旋身飞跃。: ◆ Passive: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.
lines.◆ Passive: 当 Inaros 受到致命伤害时，他会将自己封入石棺中，并: ◆ Passive: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.
lines.◆ Passive: 当 Nokko 受到致命伤害后会恢复为菌宝形态，其激活的蘑: ◆ Passive: Upon receiving fatal damage, Nokko reverts to his Sprodling form and his active mushrooms will glow, reviving Nokko when touched. Orbs spawned will grant a speed boost but not healing. If a glowing mushroom is not reached in time, Nokko will automatically use a self-revive.
lines.◆ Passive: 拥有双倍过载护盾容量。任务开始时获得最大能量。: ◆ Passive: Overshield capacity doubled. Start missions at maximum energy.
lines.◆ Passive: 每个对敌人产生影响的电击异常状态使 Gyre 的技能有 1: ◆ Passive: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.
lines.◆ Passive: 每当 Titania 施放一个技能时，她将为自身和附近队友: ◆ Passive: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.

lines.一个可以让漂泊者稍作休息的地方。: A place for a Drifter to lay their head.

lines.一个备受喜爱的星日 Ticker 玩偶。: A well-loved Star Days Ticker floof.

lines.一个带有支架的灯球。: A globe light with a bracket.

lines.一个常见的装饰，用以区分库狛是忠于何人。: A common adornment used to distinguish a Kubrow that is loyal to its master.
lines.一个异界的话痨芽灵，却戴上了一个寡言少语之人的面具。他们的身影是否曾经交汇，无人: An otherworldly sproutfolk of many words dons the mask of a man of few. Where, if e'er, their frames have crossed, none can guess. A glyph designed by community artist DasterCreations.
lines.一个投射全息图像的联盟徽章。需要您氏族中创建联盟的将军上传图像作为联盟徽章。: An insignia that projects a holographic image of your alliance emblem. Requires a Warlord in the clan that created the alliance to upload an image of the alliance emblem.
lines.一个投射氏族象征的全息图像徽记。需要你氏族的军阀上传图像作为氏族徽章。: An insignia that projects a holographic image of the clan emblem. Requires your clan's Warlord to upload an image of the clan emblem.
lines.一个指挥官用来控制其网络权限的开关。: A switch used by operators to control access to their network.
lines.一个描绘着 Ostron 传奇的巨大千年灵鱼的玻璃雕刻。: A glass carving depicting the colossal Thousand-Year Fish of Ostron legend.
lines.一个曲翼配置的可摆姿势的比例模型。: A posable, scale model of your Archwing loadout.

lines.一个杯子，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中描述的市民生活。: Sip from this mug as you assess what the morning sky has in store.

lines.一个标牌，用绿色颜料涂抹，由回收来的浮木制成。是希图斯街道和小巷中常见之物。: A sign, daubed with green pigment and crafted from reclaimed driftwood. A common feature of the streets and byways of Cetus.

lines.一个橙白相间的交通锥。: An orange and white traffic cone.
lines.一个欢快且发光的笑脸照亮你的夜晚。当然，它和死亡有关。: A cheery, glowing grin to light your nights. With deth, naturally.

lines.一个用于轨道飞行器的地球星球投影。: A planet Earth projection for the Orbiter.
lines.一个用以庆祝重建我们原来失去的中继站的 Liset 外观。: A Liset pattern to celebrate the reconstruction of our lost relay.

lines.一个祝福农历新年的传统字符。: A traditional character to bless the New Lunar Year.

lines.一个等比例缩小可动的利润收割者圆蜘模型。: A posable, scale model of the Profit-Taker Orb!

lines.一件骨盔上恣意生长着扭曲、多肉的感染触手。: A crown of bone spawns a mass of writhing, meaty, Infested tentacles.
lines.一份极为罕见的漫画图像，记录了战甲 Yareli 史上首次已知的冒险。: An exceedingly rare Graphica chronicling the first known adventure of the Warframe Yareli.
lines.一位强大战士的战斗面貌。像巨石一般不可思议，像锤击一样毫不宽容。: The battle-visage of a formidable warrior. Inscrutable as a monolith, implacable as a hammer-blow.
lines.一位无名航道特工的日志。给着陆器平添了一份古雅。: Logs of an unknown rail agent. A quaint addition to any lander.
lines.一位熟练的骑手将虚空的印记重新应用在他的绝灵骥上。: A skilled rider repurposes the Void’s mark for their Kaithe.
lines.一位自信的勇士会大踏步迈入战斗，但真正的无耻之徒会以更浮夸的举动来宣告他们的存在: A confident warrior strides into battle, but the truly brazen announce their presence with an ostentatious flourish. The Rhoptron is Protea's signature syandana.
lines.一位英雄骑乘着忠诚的绝灵骥，就像《双衍王境故事集》中描绘的那样。: A hero on the back of a loyal Kaithe, as described in the storybook, Tales of Duviri.
lines.一位超凡脱俗的女巫，色彩酿造师。受 Lotus 的启发，她精心调配并缝制了一套相: An otherworldly witch, Brewer of Hues. Inspired by the Lotus, she brewed and stitched an outfit befit. A Display designed by the community artist Luckygoblinnn.
lines.一具搭配西伯利亚战锤的水晶配件。: A crystallized companion to the Sibear hammer.
lines.一副执行者 Ballas 的肖像画。: A portrait of a Executor Ballas.
lines.一副由提奇鲁派武器工匠所打造的华美外观。: An ornate skin forged by the Tekelu School of weaponsmiths.
lines.一副造型优美的披饰，展现出要在云间遨游的渴望。: A sleek Syandana that yearns to journey among the clouds.
lines.一包 200 个，办公室会感谢你这些可生物降解的顶级隔热纸杯！: With a pack of 200, your office will thank you for these biodegradable top-of-the-line, insulated paper cups!
lines.一只可爱的兔兔玩偶，以纪念月亮的陪伴。: A cuddly rabbit floof, to honor the moon’s companion.
lines.一只可爱的老虎玩偶，以纪念传说中能够抵抗地球恶霸的动物。: A cuddly tiger floof, to honor the animal who legends say stood up to the bullies of Earth.
lines.一只完全不为所动的库娃躲在了百人夏至披饰下。: A thoroughly unimpressed Kavat takes shelter beneath a Centuria Towsun Syandana.
lines.一只带来毁灭的幽灵，Nekros 用这鬼魅的外观打破地府的藩篱。: A specter of destruction, Nekros breaks free of the underworld with this haunting skin.
lines.一只幽幽鹰从夜枭的书页中升起，在轨道飞行器中陪伴你。: A Paragrimm ascends from Noctua's pages to accompany you in your Orbiter.
lines.一只抗血清注射器的部件。获取地点：阋神星的 Oestrus: A component of the Antiserum Injector. Location: Oestrus on Eris
lines.一只裂口的陶土水壶，但被金子修复，它的不完美反而平添了一种美。: A glazed earthenware jug, cracked, but healed with gold and all the more beautiful for its imperfections.
lines.一只靴子，可能是 Grineer 设计，从遍布夜灵平野的某个池塘中钓出。闻起来有: A single boot, possibly of Grineer design, pulled from one of the ponds that dot the Eidolon Plains. Smells of Gulper and pondscum.
lines.一只颁发给在毁灭之眼行动中证明了自身能耐的 Tenno 精英的纹章。: An insignia awarded to the Tenno Elite who proved themselves during Operation Eyes of Blight.
lines.一台 Tenno 设计的清洁无人机，继承了 Liset 优雅的设计风格。: A Tenno engineered cleaning drone designed in the elegant style of the Liset.
lines.一台能显示自定信息的: A beacon capable of displaying custom messages.
lines.一名真正的猎人将他们的工具放在身边。一个可置于轨道飞行器的装饰。: A true hunter keeps their tools close at hand. A decoration for your Orbiter.
lines.一名老诈术师的新伪装外观。: A new guise for an old trickster.
lines.一名追猎者的追随者所掉落的徽章。: An insignia dropped by an Acolyte of the Stalker.
lines.一场庄重的舞蹈，堪称上流社会的典范。可在军械库的携带装备轮盘选项卡中装备此表情动: A stately dance worthy of polite society. Equip this emote using the Gear Wheel tab in your Arsenal.
lines.一块悬挂在 Caliban 奥菲欧的右肩上方的 Sentient 护甲碎片。: A fragment of Sentient armor suspended above Caliban Orfeo’s right shoulder.
lines.一块暖色调的纯粹伊莱体块，从夜灵平野的低地中回收而来。: A warmly-colored nugget of pure Iradite, reclaimed from the lowlands of the Eidolon Plains.
lines.一声温柔的低吟，一首天籁之音。由社区艺术家 cyanfacade 创作。: A motherly hum, a celestial tune. Created by community artist cyanfacade.
lines.一大筐来自希图斯市场的蓝色香料。: A large basket piled high with blue-colored spice from the markets of Cetus.
lines.一大组描绘各种太空场景的海报。: A large set of posters depicting various space scenes.
lines.一套专为漂泊者设计的套服，完美体现了极致的奥罗金风格和奢华。: A suit for the Drifter embodying the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury.
lines.一套利用 Sentient 技术发展出的护甲套装。: An evolving armor set that draws upon Sentient technology.
lines.一套利用 Sentient 技术发展出的护甲套装。装备这套护甲击败 Sentie: An evolving armor set that draws upon Sentient technology. Defeat Sentient enemies with this Armor equipped to unlock an additional look.
An evolving armor set that draws upon Sentient technology. Defeat Sentient enemies with this Armor equipped to unlock two additional looks.

lines.一幅哲士扬塔的彩绘肖像。: A painted portrait of Archimedean Yonta.
lines.一幅在福尔图娜大厅上出现的海报。: One of the many posters found on the concourses of Fortuna.
lines.一幅气势磅礴的 Ballas 画像。由 Sillfix 完成艺术创作。: An imposing portrait of Ballas. Art created by Sillfix.
lines.一幅绘影者的肖像，隐藏着墨色晕染的秘密。: A portrait of the Shadowgrapher, concealing ink-washed secrets.
lines.一座古代遗物？装饰品？这东西哪来的？上面写了些什么？又是谁写的？: A relic? A trinket? How did it get here? What does it say? Who wrote this?
lines.一座小型 Equinox Prime 摇头娃娃。: A small wobbly statue of Equinox Prime.
lines.一座由肉体和软骨构成且会扭动的塔。该 Prex 卡牌的构思和插图由 DebbyS: A writhing tower of flesh and gristle. Prex designed and illustrated by DebbySheen!
lines.一张出自大师拉夫·塞格拉斯的神秘景幕。: An enigmatic vistagraph by the master herself, Raff Seglass.
lines.一张华丽的展示图，由 Sillfix 创作。: An ornate display, created by Sillfix.
lines.一张坚固的桌子，在上面你可以享受由士魂大帝慷慨赐予的营养丰富的简单谷物。: A sturdy table on which to enjoy the nutritious dole of simple grains which Thrax’s generosity has blessed you with.
lines.一张基于 Baro Ki'teer 穿戴款式所设计的面具，适用于守护。: A mask designed to match the one worn by Baro Ki'Teer, for your Sentinel pet.
lines.一张始源星系的装饰插图。: A decorative illustration of the Origin System.
lines.一张宠物的舒适小床。: A comfortable bed for your pet.
lines.一张展示各种微观细胞的小型海报。: A small poster displaying kinds of microscopic cells.
lines.一张描绘 Nokko 与所有生命相连的海报。: A poster depicting Nokko and his connection to all life.
lines.一张描绘特定面部表情的卡片，旨在帮助识别情绪。: A card depicting a certain facial expression, intended to help with identifying emotions.
lines.一张最初展示在扎里曼教室中的马海报。: A horse poster originally displayed in a Zariman classroom.
lines.一张给轨道飞行器的库狛和库娃的海报。: A poster of a Kubrow and Kavat for your Orbiter.
lines.一把为法老所铸造的长剑。可将这种刀刃呈弯曲状的外观用于任何单手长剑之上。: A sword forged for a pharaoh. Bestow the form of this curved blade on any one-handed longsword.
lines.一把可靠手枪的古老外观。: An ancient look for a reliable pistol.
lines.一把可靠的宝剑是战士的灵魂。这把饰有橙色闪光的侍刃外观，是 Tau 上每一位禁卫: A trusty sword is the soul of a warrior. This nikana skin, decorated by flashes of orange, is carried by each Dax Gladius on Tau.
lines.一把堕落解密钥匙，起源可以追溯到 Corposium 之城建立的时期。当帕尔沃斯: A corrupted decryption key dating back to the founding of the city of Corposium. Millions of these Holokeys were lost to the Void when Parvos Granum's flagship was bombed. Strongly desired by Ergo Glast.
lines.一把永恒武器的古老外观。: An ancient look for a timeless weapon.
lines.一把精致的凳子。非常适合实验室工作和深度专注。: A sophisticated stool. Perfect for lab work and deep concentration.
lines.一把锻造自深渊的武器。: A weapon forged in the depths.
lines.一把镀金的椅子，上面铺着上好的丝绸。这是坐下来沉思宇宙和外宇宙的绝佳位置。: A gilded chair upholstered with the finest silk. The perfect spot to sit and contemplate the Universe and beyond.
lines.一把降低挥动速度而提高每次挥动所造成之伤害的变种重型斧头。: A Heavy Axe variation that grants additional damage but with a decrease in swing speed.
lines.一支已逝乐队仅存成员的签名海报。由社区艺术家 ZliDe 设计。: A signed poster of the remaining members of a lost band. Designed by community artist ZliDe.
lines.一整套装饰着酷热造型的玛戈护甲。: A set of Maggor Armor that has been adorned with a sizzling design.
lines.一旦经过清洗和鞣制后，这种器官可以变成耐用的皮革。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的: Once cleaned and tanned this organ can be turned into a durable leather. Source: Cut from Yogwun fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Yogwun in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.一束来自扎里曼的红色和黄色的鲜花。: A bouquet of red and yellow flowers from the Zariman.
lines.一条具有独特镀铬装饰的飘逸缎带披饰。: A unique chrome twist on this flowing ribbon syandana.
lines.一条指挥官套装的束腰组件。: A waistband component for an Operator outfit.
lines.一条改款节庆版的凯旋将军披饰: A festive variation of the Imperator Syandana.
lines.一条漂泊者套装的束腰组件。: A waistband component for a Drifter outfit.
lines.一条表示支持的缎带。永远纪念着关于 Andrea 的美好回忆，她的心思意念将会一: A ribbon of support. Forever in Loving Memory of Andrea, whose mind and heart will live on forever in her creations.
lines.一枚 Madurai 学派信徒所佩戴的胸章。: A badge sported by adherents of the Madurai School.

lines.一枚徽章，颁发给所有在西塞罗危机中帮助消灭 Grineer 毒素的勇士。: An emblem awarded to all those who helped destroy the Grineer toxin during the Cicero Crisis.
lines.一枚描绘 Corpus 勤奋创始人帕尔沃斯·格拉努形象的浮印。: A Corpus Glyph in the image of their industrious Founder, Parvos Granum.

lines.一枚描绘了 Vazarin 符号的荧音浮印，可用作装饰。: A Vosphene Glyph of the Vazarin symbol, usable as a decoration.
lines.一枚描绘了 Zenurik 符号的荧音浮印，可用作装饰。: A Vosphene Glyph of the Zenurik symbol, usable as a decoration.

lines.一枚描绘着 Kela De Thaym 的纹章: A sigil depicting Kela De Thaym.

lines.一枚纪念你冷酷坠入玻璃匠疯狂深渊的徽章。: An emblem commemorating your grim descent into the madness of the Glassmaker.
lines.一枚纪念你冷酷坠入玻璃匠疯狂深渊的纹章。: A sigil commemorating your grim descent into the madness of the Glassmaker.

lines.一枚颁发给在《行动代号：兽之腹》中，成功阻止了 Jade 的不稳定微粒落入帕尔沃: An emblem available to clan members who kept Jade's Volatile Motes out of the hands of Parvos Granum in Operation: Belly of the Beast.
lines.一株有张开的矛形叶的小植株。: A small plant with splayed, lanceolate leaves.
lines.一株枝条交错、秋叶繁茂的独特盆景。: A unique bonsai with crossed branches and autumn foliage.
lines.一株由 Corpus 实验室所培育的实验性植物。: An experimental plant developed in the Corpus labs.
lines.一株长有小叶子的绿色植物。: A green plant with small leaves.
lines.一根小的虚空天使羽毛，被塑造成无害的装饰物。: A small Void Angel feather, fashioned into a harmless decoration.
lines.一根虚空天使羽毛，作为一种纪念品，或者是一件战利品。: A Void Angel feather, kept as a memento, or perhaps a trophy.
lines.一棵涂沃树的树苗。: A sapling of a Tuvul tree.
lines.一次性物品，可以立即在干船坞内修复一件损坏的部件或军备。: This single-use item instantly repairs a damaged component or armament in the Dry Dock.
lines.一款上古奥罗金护甲，佩给最忠实和受人青睐的库狛看守者。: Ancient Orokin armor for the most faithful and favored Kubrow wardens.
lines.一款与神王相配的战盔。: A battle helm fit for a God King.
lines.一款为你的手枪带来滚滚云烟般的飘渺外观。: A skin to provide a billowing, ethereal look for your pistol.
lines.一款为你的次要武器所设计的迷人的专属热忱外观。: An alluring exclusive Verv skin for your sidearm.
lines.一款为盗贼双枪所设计的迷人的专属热忱外观。: An enthralling exclusive Verv skin for the Afuris.
lines.一款为黑暗舵手 Sevagoth 设计的流动且轮廓分明的披饰。: A flowing, contoured Syandana for Sevagoth, the dark Helmsman.
lines.一款以 Tau 自由派解放者光肃官所使用的战锤为原型设计的战锤外观。: A skin for hammers modeled after those wielded by the Anarch Libritor Lustratus on Tau.
lines.一款供战甲用的次世代纹章。: A next-generation sigil for your Warframe.
lines.一款充满设计感的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。适用于漂泊者。: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
lines.一款光彩照人的护甲套装，亦能抵御死亡的侵袭。: A resplendent armor set and a ward against death.
lines.一款具有异国情调，且引人注目的弓类武器外观。: An exotic and eye-catching Bow skin.
lines.一款具有精致亮点与独特科技元素的弧形披饰。: An arcing syandana with refined highlights and distinctive technical elements.
lines.一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化幻纹。: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology.
lines.一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化幻纹。装备这款幻纹获取专精点数时会: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock an additional look.
An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock two additional looks.
lines.一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology.
lines.一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。装备这款披饰收集遗物和阿耶精: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics and Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock an additional look.
lines.一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。装备这款披饰收集遗物或阿耶精: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics or Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock two additional looks.
lines.一款受 Corpus 所启发的披饰，反映穿着者的状态，受到伤害时披饰展开。: A Corpus-inspired Syandana that responds to the wearer's well-being, unfolding in response to damage. As you endure the Flox unfolds.
lines.一款古老的金色披饰，只有那些被挑选出来带领奥罗金高阶枢密院的勇士才能佩戴。: An ancient and golden syandana, worn only by those chosen to lead the Orokin High Court.
lines.一款可怕的替代头盔，让 Caliban 重现自远古之战以来就从未穿戴过的造型。: A fearsome alternative helmet to give Caliban a look he has not worn since the Old War.
lines.一款向海盗 DJ 诺拉·夜的永恒漫游之家致敬的登陆艇型号。时刻保持强大与敏锐吧，: A landing craft model that pays homage to the forever-wandering home of pirate DJ Nora Night. Stay deadly, Dreamers. Nightwave's air support releases powerful sound waves, destroying weaker enemies while stunning more powerful ones.
lines.一款嗜血的噬蛇弩外观，适合喜欢近距离使用弩的玩家。: A bloodthirsty Nagantaka skin for those who prefer to use a crossbow at close range.
lines.一款在战场及虚空流电的旋涡上舞动的披饰。: A Syandana that dances upon the eddies of battle and void-currents alike.
lines.一款大胆改装的传统 Grineer 护甲。: A venturous adaptation of traditional Grineer armor.
lines.一款尊贵且别具一格的枪刃外观——Titania 女皇外观的绝佳陪衬。: A regal, otherworldly gunblade skin - and a striking accompaniment to Titania's Empress skin.
lines.一款展示两位好友一起打游戏的个人档案浮印。: A glyph for your profile featuring two best buds playing games together.
lines.一款带有纹理的红黑色长棍外观。: A textured red and black Staff skin.
lines.一款庆祝马年的个人档案浮印。: A glyph for your profile celebrating the Year of the Horse.
lines.一款引人注目的全新外观，拥有星系中最神秘的商人的风格，适用于你喜爱的机械宠物。: A striking new skin for your favorite automatic pet, in the style of the System's most enigmatic trader.
lines.一款护甲设计，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills.
lines.一款派头十足的鲜红色步枪外观。: A bold red Rifle skin with extra panache.
lines.一款灵感来自于强大的 Sentient 骨螺战舰的枪刃外观。: A gunblade skin inspired by the mighty Sentient Murex.
lines.一款灵感来自风度翩翩的虚空商人 Baro Ki'Teer 的调色盘。: A color palette inspired by Baro Ki’Teer, the debonair Void Trader.
lines.一款独特的眼饰，由 Theriondrek 和 Vhynnz 设计。: A unique oculus, designed by Theriondrek and Vhynnz.
lines.一款独特的眼饰，由 Ventralhound 设计。: A unique oculus, designed by Ventralhound.
lines.一款独特的面具，由 Ventralhound 设计。: A unique mask, designed by Ventralhound.
lines.一款由远古 Tenno 设计的优雅长棍，浮萍上挂着一条丝带，可以在你攻击时分散对: An elegant staff of ancient Tenno design, the Lemnas dangles with a ribbon that distracts as you attack.
lines.一款科技有机披饰，重塑奥罗金精英的高贵气质。: A techno-organic Syandana, reimagined with regal flair worthy of the Orokin elite.
lines.一款节庆版的代达罗斯胸甲。: A festive rendition of the Daedalus breastplate.
lines.一款行刑者 Vay Molta 的浮印: A glyph of Executioner Vay Molta
lines.一款行刑者多克·图尔的浮印: A glyph of Executioner Dok Thul
lines.一款诱人而可怕的守护尾部。: A deliciously nightmarish tail for your Sentinel.
lines.一款诱人而可怕的守护面具。: A deliciously nightmarish mask for your Sentinel.
lines.一款造型别致的披饰，深受豪爽美食家 Grendel 的青睐。: A most curious syandana, and one favored by the gallant gourmand, Grendel.
lines.一款长棍外观，再现了禁卫医疗兵在战场上所携带的武器，象征着胜利的希望。: A staff skin that replicates the weapon carried by Dax Capsarii into battle as a symbol of hope for victory.
lines.一段气势磅礴的升腾动作，让人想起英魂统使投入战斗时的场景。: A dramatic ascent evoking the Hunhullus' entry into battle.
lines.一盆用于轨道飞行器的装饰花架。: A decorative planter for the orbiter.
lines.一种 Ostron 珍馐。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从诺格鱼中切割获: An Ostron delicacy. Source: Cut from Norg fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Norg in the Plains of Eidolon lake at Night using Norg Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.一种 Tenno 展现力量与技术的演示，会以一个鞠躬作为收尾。: A Tenno display of power and technique, followed up with a short bow.
lines.一种与众不同的声音。使用这把独特音响的金紫色的三线琴弹拨一首颂歌给 Lotus。: A sound like no other. Strum an ode to the Lotus with this unique sounding gold and violet Shawzin. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
lines.一种主要用于签署文书的华丽书写工具。: An ornate writing implement used primarily to sign paperwork.
lines.一种具有精致球形结构的白色花朵。: A white flower with a delicate orb-shaped structure.
lines.一种原产于地球、其黄色花朵在日光下卷起的植物。: A plant whose yellow blooms furl in the daylight native to Earth.
lines.一种原产于地球、其黄色花朵在月光下绽放的多叶植物。: A leafy plant whose yellow blooms unfurl in the moonlight native to Earth.
lines.一种原产于地球、只在白天盛开的下垂百合。: A drooping lily that blooms only in daylight native to Earth.
lines.一种原产于地球的娇嫩百合，仅在夜间绽放。: A delicate lily native to Earth that blooms only at night.
lines.一种原产于夜灵平野、带有爪状附属物的多刺多肉植物。: A prickly succulent with claw-like appendages native to the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.一种原产于奥布山谷、带有虹彩结节的铁锈色灌木。: A rust-colored shrub with iridescent nodule native to the Orb Vallis.
lines.一种原产于寒冷地区、低矮的多叶灌木。: A low-growing leafy shrub native to cold regions.
lines.一种原产于月球的淡色猪笼草。: A pale pitcher plant native to Lua.
lines.一种原产于谷神星、在有毒环境中茁壮成长的猪笼草。: A pitcher plant that thrives under toxic conditions native to Ceres.
lines.一种反熵辐射来源，用于强化合成生命体，尤其是执刑官和战甲。: A source of anti-entropic radiation ideal for empowering synthetic lifeforms, most notably Archons and Warframes.
lines.一种古老的权力象征，既神圣又世俗。: An ancient symbol of power, both sacred and profane.
lines.一种只能在夜灵平野上找到的气体，已被精炼到了最纯粹的状态。获取地点：夜灵平野赏金: A gas found solely on the Plains of Eidolon, refined to its purest form. Location: Plains of Eidolon Bounties on Earth
lines.一种可能具有放射性的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。获取地点：深矿赏: A potentially radioactive mushroom. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information. Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
lines.一种叶形优美的植物，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A plant with elegantly-shaped leaves designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一种坚硬、热塑性的塑料套管。由 Corpus 制造。获取地点：水星，金星和天王星: A hard, thermoplastic casing. Manufactured by Corpus. Location: Mercury, Venus, and Uranus
lines.一种外观奇特，仿佛不属于这个世界的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。获: A peculiar looking mushroom that seems not of this world. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information. Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
lines.一种带有尖刺的红叶植物，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A plant with spiky red leaves designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一种带有缠绕卷须的肉色蘑菇，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A flesh-colored mushroom with creeping tendrils designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一种常见于游戏厅的弹球机。: A pinball machine typically found in an arcade.
lines.一种常见于游戏厅的桌上足球桌。: A foosball table typically found in arcade.
lines.一种常见于游戏厅的空气曲棍球台。: An air hockey table typically found in arcades.
lines.一种常见于游戏厅的街机赛车。: A racing game typically found in an arcade.
lines.一种开着蓝花的多肉植物，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A succulent with bright blue flowers designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一种形状像太阳的植物，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A plant shaped like the sun designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一种形状古怪的真菌，会附着在金属物体上。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽那里了解更多信息。: An oddly shaped fungus that will latch itself onto metallic objects. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information. Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus

lines.一种有橙色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子: An Ostron rug featuring orange bands.
lines.一种有红色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子: An Ostron rug featuring red bands.
lines.一种有绿色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子: An Ostron rug featuring green bands.
lines.一种有蓝色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子: An Ostron rug featuring blue bands.
lines.一种有黄色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子: An Ostron rug featuring yellow bands.
lines.一种来历和效应都不明的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。获取地点：深矿: A mushroom of unknown origin or effect. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information. Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
lines.一种来自地球树木的种子，于夜间掉落。: A seed that falls at night from trees native to Earth.
lines.一种来自地球树木的种子，于白天掉落。: A seed that falls in daytime from trees native to Earth.
lines.一种来自地球的小型啮齿类，可以在轨道飞行器中伴随你。: A small rodent of Earthly origin to keep you company aboard the Orbiter.
lines.一种来自奥布山谷的蕨类植物。: A fern from the Orb Vallis.
lines.一种来自虚空的放射性资源，离开虚空后将每天衰变。获取地点：虚空中的任务: A Void based radioactive resource that decays every day it is out of the Void. Location: Missions in the Void
lines.一种栖息在火卫二洞穴中的鱼类。该 Prex 卡牌的构思和插图由 Shadrad: A cave dwelling Fish of Deimos. Prex designed and illustrated by Shadrad!
lines.一种生活在火卫二的三尾鱼类。该 Prex 卡牌的构思和插图由 Shadrad 创: A triple tailed Fish of Deimos. Prex designed and illustrated by Shadrad!
lines.一种生活在火卫二的鞭鱼。该 Prex 卡牌的构思和插图由 Shadrad 创作！: A whippy spined Fish of Deimos. Prex designed and illustrated by Shadrad!
lines.一种生长在地球森林中的大型蕨类植物，具有宽阔的淡绿色叶片。: A large fern with broad, pale green leaves found in the forests of Earth.
lines.一种生长在小行星岩石地形上的避光苔藓。: A light-shunning moss that grows on the rocky terrain of asteroids.
lines.一种生长在火星 Grineer 驻扎地的多刺喜阴植物。: A bristly, shade-loving plant found in Grineer settlements on Mars.
lines.一种用于 Sentient 通讯流的适应性基本组件。在合一众入侵时被广泛使用。对: An adaptive Sentient base component responsible for communication flows. Used extensively in the Narmer invasion. A valuable commodity for both The Quills and Vox Solaris. Location: Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and Orb Vallis (Venus)
lines.一种用于烹饪各种营养块美味的设备。: A device for preparing a variety of nutrition cube dishes.
lines.一种用来增加遗物内在能力的物质。获取地点：虚空裂缝任务: A substance used to increase the power within Relics. Location: Void Fissure Missions
lines.一种用来集中精神的姿势。: A pose to focus one's mind.
lines.一种绝迹玫瑰的稀有刺，是奥罗金咒言板及其它技术中的关键组件。最后一次被看到是在深: The rare thorn of an extinct rose, and a vital component in Orokin Defixios and other technology. Last seen near the Abyssal Zone. Location: Abyssal Zone on Ceres (requires Abyssal Beacons to access)
lines.一种羽叶纤细、根须下垂的蕨类植物。: A fern with thin fronds and trailing roots.
lines.一种蓝叶植物，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A plant with blue foliage designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一种蛇形的蘑菇，处理时应格外小心。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。获取地点: A snake-like mushroom that should be handled with caution. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information. Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
lines.一种褶叶植物，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A plant with frilly leaves the color of twilight designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一种退化的 Helminth 疾冲者品种: A degenerated strain of the Helminth Charger.
lines.一种适合夜间狩猎的库娃花纹。: A kavat pattern ideal for the nighttime hunt.
lines.一种适用于爪类武器的仿生外观。: A biotic look for claw weapons.
lines.一种通常用于生产超高可燃性燃料的试剂。获取地点：木星: A reagent commonly used to produce highly combustible fuel. Location: Jupiter
lines.一种金叶灌木，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A golden-leafed plant designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一种银叶灌木，其设计模仿了《双衍王境故事集》中描述的植物。: A silver-leafed bush designed to look like the flora described in Tales of Duviri.
lines.一簇黄色的小雏菊，掩映在树叶之间。: A cluster of small yellow daisies nestled between leaves.
lines.一系列供夜灵兆力使、夜灵巨力使与夜灵水力使可动模型使用的姿势组合包: A collection of poses for Eidolon Teralyst, Eidolon Gantulyst and Eidolon Hydrolyst articulas.
lines.一系列儿童手工作品，包含科学插图、库娃和库狛折纸。: A collection of childrens crafts, including science illustrations and origami Kavats and Kubrows.
lines.一系列灵感来自合一众崇拜组织的色彩。: A selection of colors inspired by the Narmer cult.
lines.一系统蝠力使的可动模型站姿。: A collection of poses for the Ropalolyst Articula.
lines.一组 Corpus 船员的动作。: A collection of poses for Corpus Crewmen.
lines.一组 Grineer 步兵的动作。: A collection of poses for Grineer footsoldiers.
lines.一组为你的宠物准备的护甲套装，以猛虎霰弹枪令人生畏的锋利外观为蓝本。: An armor set for your pet, modeled on the intimidating, bladed look of the Tigris Shotgun.
lines.一组从敌方卓越者的制服衍生而来的色彩包。解锁更多用于战甲的自定义色彩。: A set of colors derived from the uniforms of Eximus adversaries. Unlocks additional color options for Warframe customization.
lines.一组大胆的颜色，用来纪念 Vauban 的传承。: A selection of bold colors honoring Vauban’s legacy.
lines.一组尊贵的颜色，用来纪念 Valkyr 的传承。: A selection of regal colors honoring Valkyr’s legacy.
lines.一组崭新大胆、用精致棱晶制成的库狛护甲。: A bold set of Kubrow armor coated in delicate Prisma crystals.
lines.一组庆祝骄傲月的颜色。: A set of colors to celebrate Pride.
lines.一组持枪姿势组合包。: A collection of poses with guns.
lines.一组源自于奥罗金帝国遗迹的颜色包。解锁更多用于战甲的自定义色彩。: A set of colors derived from the relics of the Orokin Empire. Unlocks additional color options for Warframe customization.
lines.一组特別赐给 Corpus 精英华贵展示品，如今成为与之对抗的 Tenno 的战: An opulent display of privilege for the Corpus elite becomes a trophy for the Tenno who fight them.
lines.一组独一无二，适用于全弓类武器的箭矢。: A unique set of arrows, compatible with any bow.
lines.一组生动而鲜艳的颜色，用来纪念 Rhino 的传承。: A selection of vibrant colors honoring Rhino’s legacy.
lines.一组用于自定义界面的音效: A custom set of UI sounds.
lines.一组装备了曲翼的 Tenno 的动作。: A collection of poses for Tenno with Archwing.
lines.一艘用于轨道飞行器的 Sentient 骨螺战舰投影。: A Sentient Murex projection for the Orbiter.
lines.一部分遗失多年的数学证明片段: One part of a long lost mathematical proof.
lines.一顶共同的头盔让武装的 Grineer 兄弟们团结一心。: A common helmet unifies Grineer brothers in arms.
lines.一顶属于指挥官套装的头套。: A hood belonging to an Operator outfit.
lines.一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
lines.一颗将经验值转换为五项 Tenno 之道专精的高级晶体。: A Greater Lens that channels Affinity into Focus for one of the five Tenno Ways.
lines.一颗注入了夜灵之息的强化高级晶体。: An enhanced Greater Lens that has been infused with Breath of the Eidolon.
lines.一颗温暖的 Sentient 核心装饰，借由过去所拥有的力量仍在发光。: A single, warm Sentient core decoration for your orbiter - still illuminated by a shred of the power it once commanded.
lines.一颗用流水画成的爱心。一件来自 Yareli 充满爱意的轨道飞行器装饰。: A heart drawn in living water. An Orbiter decoration, from Yareli, with love.
lines.一颗通过活体纤维的共振来强化的夜灵晶体。: An Eidolon Lens enhanced with resonance from Somatic Fibers.
lines.一首为 Sevagoth 格劳克斯的幽影在战斗时播放的自定歌曲。也可以在轨道飞行: A custom song for Sevagoth Glaukus that plays when his Shadow is in combat. It can also be played on the Somachord in your Orbiter.
lines.七十二变者、斗战者、大圣。Wukong 齐天大圣傲立巅峰，夺得了属于他的王者称号: Trickster, warrior, king. Wukong Qitian emerges supreme to claim his rightful title.
lines.万物皆有联系。孢子会随着这些幻纹萦绕在你的脚印，唤起地下的生命之网。: Everything is connected. Spores linger in your footsteps with this ephemera, evoking the underground web of life.
lines.丈夫与妻子，黎明与黄昏。Equinox 的标志性剑盾外观。: Husband and wife, dawn and dusk. A signature Sword and Shield skin for Equinox.
lines.三道绕轨能量在你身上环绕 — 在钢铁之路上获取。: Surround yourself with a trio of orbiting energy - earned on the Steel Path.
lines.不必害怕 Jade 在轨道飞行器中注视的目光。: Be not afraid with Jade's gaze in your Orbiter.
lines.不朽之神、战甲之王。登上王座并成为 Inaros 拉美西斯。: A god among mortals. A king among Warframes. Ascend the throne and become Inaros Ramses.
lines.不朽的 Wukong 三摩提从大釜之火中诞生。: From the cauldron's flame emerges the immortal Wukong Samadhi.
lines.不祥之手为你的登陆艇增色。: Ominous hands grace your Landing Craft.
lines.不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
lines.不要让任何事情阻碍你保护你所珍视的人。: Let nothing hinder you from safeguarding those you hold dear.
lines.与 Banshee 女高音外观配套的肩甲。: Shoulder armor matching the Banshee Soprana Skin.
lines.与 Hildryn 英灵外观相配的野火充能外观。: A Balefire Charger skin to match the Hildryn Einheri skin.
lines.与 Ivara 黑曜石外观相配的月神狩弓外观。: Artemis Bow skin to match the Ivara Obsidian skin.
lines.与 Mesa 投射使外观相配的监察者双枪外观。: Regulator skins to match the Mesa Projectilyst Skin.
lines.与 Mesa 边塞外观相配的监察者双枪外观: Regulator skins to match the Mesa Presidio Skin.
lines.与你的库狛或库娃互动: Interact with your Kubrow or Kavat
lines.与其肮脏的来源有天壤之别的对称晶体。火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。: Crystalline symmetry, a far cry from its corrupt origin. Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.
lines.与宿主共生的良性感染组织。: A benign Infestation existing symbiotically with its host.
lines.与库狛的海诺祖先匹配的毛皮花纹，来自库狛大师 Skvirl 保存下来的一个基因序: Fur pattern matching your Kubrow's Heino ancestors, from a gene-line preserved by Kubrow master Skvirl. [Tenno's Best Friend Contest winner]
lines.与曲翼枪械武器融合以解锁其两个可用的赋能槽位之一。: Fuses with an Archgun weapon to unlock one of its two available Arcane Slots.
lines.与水培系统一起使用的门板。: Door panel used with hydroponic systems.
lines.与混沌虚无主义作斗争的方式变得更可爱了。: The fight against chaotic nihilism just got a little bit cuddlier.
lines.与烈焰太子相匹配的战斗服饰。: Battle dress suitable for the Prince of Flame.
lines.与虚空钥匙类似，这个物品明显与航道星舰里圣物装置的钥匙孔相匹配。: Resembling a Void Key, this object appears to be a perfect match for the empty slot in the Railjack's reliquary.
lines.与软萌的 Chroma 一起享受新春佳节。: Enjoy Lunar Renewal with this cute and cuddly Chroma by your side.
lines.与软萌的 Mirage 一起享受新春佳节。: Enjoy Lunar Renewal with this cute and cuddly Mirage by your side.
lines.与黄泉归来的灵魂作伴。: Carry the spirits of the Otherworld with you.
lines.专为奥罗金最珍贵的物品打造的底座。: A stand made for only the most precious of Orokin belongings.
lines.专为最精良品种的库狛打造。: Fashioned for the most refined breed of Kubrow.
lines.两个一半构成一个整体。与另一名拥有爱神的右手的 Tenno 一起合作该表情动作来: Two halves make a whole. Perform this emote with another Tenno's Right Hand of Eros to form a heart.
lines.两个一半构成一个整体。与另一名拥有爱神的左手的 Tenno 一起合作该表情动作来: Two halves make a whole. Perform this emote with another Tenno's Left Hand of Eros to form a heart.
lines.两个字：湿透！: We've got two words for ya: Soak it!
lines.个人档案的浮印，显示 Xaku 拉雅头盔。: A glyph for your profile, showing the Xaku Raya Helmet.
lines.个人档案的浮印，象征着你为揭开 Tau 真实历史的奉献。: A glyph for your profile, emblematic of your dedication to uncovering the true history of Tau.
lines.中枢 Ordis 总是喜欢与指挥官交谈。让他欣喜的是，现在他可以随时随地常伴指挥: Cephalon Ordis has always delighted in talking with the Operator. Now he can delight in accompanying the Operator in any situation.
lines.中枢 Simaris 的浮印。: A glyph of the Cephalon Simaris.
lines.中枢苏达的浮印: A glyph of the Cephalon Suda
lines.中枢苏达集团的勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。: Medallion of the Cephalon Suda syndicate. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
lines.为 Liset 打造的耀眼外观。: A dazzling skin for your Liset.
lines.为一个重生的赤毒玄骸打造的 Grineer 肩甲: Grineer shoulder plates forged for a reborn Kuva Lich.
lines.为一个重生的赤毒玄骸打造的 Grineer 胸甲: A Grineer chest plate forged for a reborn Kuva Lich.
lines.为一个重生的赤毒玄骸打造的 Grineer 腿甲: Grineer leg plates forged for a reborn Kuva Lich.
lines.为了保护他的族群，一位暗影战士从严冬的森林中浮现。: From winter’s forest a dark warrior emerges to protect his flock.
lines.为了纪念 Tau 的异星花而打造，它的美丽现在可以保存在你的轨道飞行器中。: Wrought in memory of the Xenoflora of Tau, its beauty can be preserved in your Orbiter.
lines.为了纪念在感染者天灾中守护了希图斯的 Tenno。: To commemorate Tenno who helped defend Cetus from the Infested scourge.
lines.为你最出色的武器打造的最精美的坠饰。: The finest Sugatra for your finest weapon.
lines.为你的典籍赋予高科技外观。: Give your tome a high-tech appearance.
lines.为你的守护装扮上唤醒巨龙的护甲，共舞新春华章。: Prepare your Sentinel for a dance of Lunar Renewal revelry with armor that invokes the dragon.
lines.为你的宠物准备的新玩具。: A new favorite toy for your pet.
lines.为你的库娃佩戴上玻璃刻雕护甲，十分适合这最高贵的野兽。: Gird your Kavat in sculpted glass armor fit for the very noblest of beasts.
lines.为你的库娃注入不可忽视的古老奥罗金血脉印记。: Imbue your Kavat with the unmistakable marks of ancient Orokin lineage.
lines.为你的私人房间准备地额外鱼缸。同时包括了一组新手鱼类。: Additional fish tank for your personal quarters. Includes a starter pack of fish.
lines.为你的轨道飞行器卫生环境来一次时髦的升级。: A stylish upgrade to your Orbiter's sanitation needs.
lines.为你的轨道飞行器摆上 Baruuk Prime 的镇静曼陀罗。有助于冥想和沉思。: Mark your orbiter with Baruuk Prime’s tranquil mandala. The configuration encourages meditation and contemplation.
lines.为侍刃镀上复杂精密的青铜外观。: Gild the Nikana with this intricate bronze skin.
lines.为供人观赏，这是一种处于零重力环境中的奇特真菌生命体。: For your viewing pleasure, a curious fungal lifeform encased in zero gravity.

lines.你个人档案中令人惶恐不安的浮印。: A haunting Glyph for your profile.
lines.你以前见过这张脸。你以前从未见过这张脸。: You have seen this face before. You have never seen this face before.

lines.你可以在这个时尚的底座上自豪地展示宝物。: Showcase your treasures with pride on this stylish pedestal.

lines.你是否像其他人一样虫化了？: Are you as wormed as the others?

lines.切片哥当前的存货储备量。通过完成卡尔的「击溃合一众」任务来增加他的存货储备量。: Chipper's current Stock level. Raise his Stock level by completing Kahl's Break Narmer missions.
lines.划痕对于这款粗犷的原子摩托车外观涂装来说不算什么。: Scratches mean nothing to this rough and ready Atomicycle livery.
lines.刚从极速赛道的下来的奥利！把这位滑板冠军带回你的轨道飞行器吧。: Fresh from the Crash Course, it’s Ollie! Give this skateboarding champ a home in your Orbiter.
lines.利润收割者圆蛛的一系列站姿。: A collection of poses for the Profit-Taker Orb Articula.
lines.利用 Sentient 对感染者的免疫力所制作的精制抗体。专为对付《瘟疫之星》赏: Sentient immunity to the Infestation is exploited with this refined phylaxis. Formulated specifically to combat Infested boils in Plague Star bounties. Location: Nakak's Operational Supply in Cetus
lines.利用这个 Koumei 掷骰浮印来孤注一掷吧。: Risk it all with this Koumei Dice Glyph.
lines.利用这套实验性的 Volt 原型外观探索往昔。: Delve into the past with this experimental prototype skin for Volt.
lines.刺影曲翼的独特外观。: A unique skin for the Itzal Archwing.
lines.刺影曲翼的默认外观。: Default skin for the Itzal Archwing.
lines.前任奥罗金禁卫将这件披饰穿在战场和典礼中，它被全帝国视为是权力的象征。: Worn in battle and ceremony by late-Orokin Dax, this Syandana was seen as a symbol of power to all in the empire.
lines.剑盾武器的标准拔刀姿态: Standard way of drawing Sword and Shields.
lines.功能未知、极其复杂的机器。: A deeply complex machine of unknown function.
lines.加满营养罐、工具充电、保护你剩下的有机部分，你需要的应有尽有。至于你如何将之展现: Everything you need to refill nutrient canisters, recharge tools and protect what organics you have remaining. How you present it in your Lander is up to you.
lines.勇往直前，投身战火。: Advance into the heat of battle.
lines.勇气披饰会在 Tenno 受到伤害时燃烧起来。: The Vaykor Syandana flares up whenever the Tenno takes damage.
lines.勇角马盔的弯角让人想起塔牧羊，据说它的快乐会带来好运。: The Dyrncaul Chamfron’s curved horns are reminiscent of the Tamm, a creature whose happiness is said to bring good fortune.
lines.勇闯异世界。没有人能够打败那些在逆境中展现荣誉、在死亡面前表现勇气的人。: Venture boldly into the Otherworld. None shall defeat the one who shows honor in the face of adversity and courage in the face of death.
lines.勒克塔的闪电迷彩外观。: The Shock-Camo skin for the Lecta.
lines.包含一个底鼓和两个嗵鼓的架子鼓。: A drum kit consisting of a base drum and two tom drums.
lines.包含库娃的遗传密码序列。获取地点：通过对漫游在火卫二奥罗金遗迹中的野生库娃使用资: Contains the genetic code sequence of a Kavat. Location: Obtained by using a Codex Scanner on Feral Kavats that roam the Orokin Derelict on Deimos
lines.包裹于丝缎，由发光的设计点缀，加扎勒令人一瞥引灵未被感染者腐化前的样貌。: Wrapped in silk and etched with glowing designs, the Gazal offers a glimpse of the Djinn uncorrupted by Infestation.
lines.包裹着幼年 Orion 的襁褓布，在狂喜的愤怒中被撕碎。: Swaddling cloth of the infant Orion, torn in ecstatic fury.
lines.包裹着幼年 Sirius 的襁褓布，被当作一枚破旧的荣誉勋章佩戴着。: Swaddling cloth of the infant Sirius, worn as a ragged badge of honor.
lines.化作动能残影，驾驭涡轮增压的 Gauss 摩托系列。无法被击中的存在，就无法被消: Become a kinetic blur with the turbocharged Gauss Moto. What cannot be hit cannot be killed.
lines.化身为赋予生命的风暴与灾变雷电之间的混沌。: Embody the chaos between life-giving storms and calamitous lightning.
lines.升级版配有两路视频输入和三路音频输入！: UPGRADED with TWO Video Inputs and THREE Audio Inputs!
lines.升级轨道飞行器的孵化器来获得以下功能： - 回退受老化基因影响的成熟同伴 - 孵: Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features: - Regress genetic aging of mature companions - Egg incubation reduced by a day
lines.升级配置的西格玛护盾阵列。: An upgraded version of the Sigma Shield Array.
lines.华丽的细节非常适合帕尔沃斯·格拉努最喜爱的守护者。: Sumptuous details suit Parvos Granum's favored guardian.
lines.华金马盔适合任何正式场合。: The Kheyur Chamfron befits any formal occasion.
lines.卟兹-兹-兹！用高能量的电弧烤熟那些坏家伙吧！Volt！: Bzz-zz-zzt! Fry the baddies with arcs of powerful energy. Volt!
lines.占位符_描述：个人档案的浮印。由社区艺术家 Searyn 创作。: PH_DESCRIPTION: A glyph for your profile. Created by Community artist Searyn.
lines.卡娅·维拉斯科是才华横溢的理科生，她为 Nova 战甲带来了人性化的一面。使用内: Kaya Velasco, a brilliant science student, brings a human face to the Nova Warframe. Switch between Nova and Kaya's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Kaya Gemini Emote, even during missions.
lines.卡娅制作这些微型反应堆是为了试验她新发现的力量，但最重要原因其实是，她就是喜欢它: Kaya fashioned these tiny reactors to experiment with her newfound powers, but more than anything, she just likes how cool they look.
lines.卡尔-175 坚守阵地保护他的战友们。: Kahl-175 stands fast to defend his brothers in arms.
lines.卡拉克使用的沙漠伪装外观。: Desert camouflage skin for the Karak.
lines.即使你知道死亡的阴影，也要爱上黎明的光芒。 Styanax 的杰出头盔。: Love the light of dawn even as you know the shadow of death. A distinguished helmet for Styanax.
lines.即使在最严重的国际事件中，也要保持时尚。: Stay stylish even during the worst of international incidents.
lines.即使是最底层的双衍王境公民，时不时也需要到达一些高度。: Even the lowest Duviri citizen may need to reach a high spot from time to time.
lines.即使是独眼战士，透过坚毅的镜片也能看得一清二楚。: Even one-eyed warriors will see clearly when they look through the lens of fortitude.
lines.即将上线的浮印™，由社区艺术家 Searyn 创作。: A glyph releasing Soon (TM), created by Community artist Searyn.
lines.即时享游戏显示器是在家中以完美的 64 位画质运行即时享系统的最佳选择。（注意：: The Kinemantik At Home (K.A.H.) Game Monitor is the best way to run your K.A.H. system at home with perfect 64-bit definition. (Note: The K.A.H. Game System is only compatible with the K.A.H. Game Monitor and will not work with any other TV or monitor.)
lines.即时享游戏系统是一种将街机游戏带入你的客厅的革命性新方式！: The Kinemantik At Home (K.A.H.) Game System is a new revolutionary way to bring the arcade to your living room!
lines.即时灵！手提音响专为让你的音乐响彻整个街区设计！: The KineMagik! Boom Box is for when you want to make sure that the entire neighborhood shares in your tunes!
lines.即时烹小烤箱非常适合小厨房或外出时使用，尤其是在没有完整厨房的情况下。使用它的烧: The KineKitchen Toaster Oven is perfect for those smaller kitchens or cooking on the go, where a full kitchen isn't available. It's amazing what you can make with it's broil and convection settings!
lines.即时烹微波炉配备专利申请中的新功能，如智能解冻和即刻爆米花！十秒内快速制作爆米花: The KineKitchen Microwave comes with brand-new patent-pending settings like SmartDefrost and Insta-Pop! Make popcorn in ten seconds or less with no burnt kernels - guaranteed!
lines.即时烹烤面包机配有四组电热管和十档加热设置，可烹制完美的酥脆早餐！: The KineKitchen toaster comes with four sets of electrical coils and ten heat settings for that perfect crispy breakfast!
lines.即时通 840 高清电视是顶级的阴极射线管电视，以优美的 4:3 比例呈现所有你: The Kinemantik 840 HD TV is the top-of-the-line cathode-ray tube television set, showing all your favorite programs in their beautiful 4:3 aspect ratio!
lines.即时通广播系统与所有主流系统兼容。配有可调节的内置音量覆盖，即使是最叫不动的部队: The Kinemantik Announce is compatible with all major systems. With an adjustable in-line volume override, it is sure to muster even the most stubborn of troops.
lines.即时通数字电话保证走到哪里都在服务区！: Kinemantik Digital Phones are guaranteed to have service absolutely everywhere!
lines.即时通移动电话保证*终生坚不可摧！ （*购买任何即时通产品，包括订阅即时通线上服: Kinemantik Cellphones are guaranteed* to be indestructible for life! (*By purchasing any Kinemantik product, including subscriptions to Kinemantik On Line, the purchaser waives all rights to pursue claims, legal remedies, or damages against Kinemantik, its affiliates, or successors, to the fullest extent permitted by law.)
lines.原为泰尔·雷工众多实验之一的预定原型，这件披饰现已易主为 Tenno 特工所使用: A prototype destined for one of Tyl Regor’s experiments, this syandana has been repurposed for Tenno Agents.
lines.原子摩托车的出厂外观涂装。: The factory created livery of the Atomicycle.
lines.原子摩托车的混色涂装。: A color shifting livery for the Atomicycle.
lines.原子矿融炮将敌人撕成灰烬，而有了这款节日彩绘外观，这个过程显得格外养眼。: The Atomos rends enemies to ash, and with this festively painted skin, looks good doing it.
lines.原子矿融炮的节庆外观。: A festive skin for the Atomos.
lines.又推出一款 Harrow 机体！由社区艺术家 ibumuc 创作。: Another Harrow Chassis just dropped! Created by Community artist ibumuc.
lines.双人科幻游戏的街机。: An arcade machine with a two player sci-fi game.
lines.双子葛拉卡达的次世代外观。: A next-generation skin for the Twin Grakatas.
lines.双子蝰蛇的次世代外观: A next-generation skin for the Twin Vipers.
lines.双持类匕首可以收起于各肩膀上。: Dual Daggers are holstered on each shoulder.
lines.双爪类武器的独特外观，由 Apollo Phoenix 设计。: A unique claws skin, designed by Apollo Phoenix
lines.双衍王境中使用过的简约厨房碗。: A simple kitchen bowl used on Duviri.
lines.双衍王境的公民必须时刻保持干净，以防士魂大帝的目光落在他们身上。: Duviri citizens are expected to keep clean at all times, in case Thrax’s gaze should fall upon them.
lines.双衍王境里绝灵骥的标准饲料，同时也是疲惫工人的简陋床铺。: Standard fodder for the Kaithes of Duviri, doubling as a humble bed for the weary laborer.
lines.反应堆用于大幅提升战甲的能力。且能将战甲、曲翼及同伴的 Mod 容量提升为两倍。: Reactor used to super-charge Warframes. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Warframe, Archwing, and Companions.
lines.发光的等离子体会在你所经之处跃出地面。: Luminous plasma leaps off surfaces in your presence.
lines.发辫和珠饰彰显射手的骄傲。: Braids and beads embody the marksman's pride.
lines.取自于战败赤毒守卫者的武器。: Ripped from the blade of a fallen Kuva Guardian.
lines.取自神圣命运梦境的彼岸。获取地点：萨娅的异象（地球）: Retrieved from the shores of a sacred fate dream. Location: Saya's Visions on Earth
lines.受到了阿耶檀识 Anasa 塑像波浪线设计的启发，Ivara 声称这是她的标志性: Inspired by the undulating design of the Anasa Ayatan sculpture, Ivara claims this as her signature armor set.
lines.受到年迈预言家们的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind.
lines.受到年迈预言家的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。适用于漂泊者。: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind. Fitted for the Drifter.
lines.只是一把普通的办公椅。仅此而已。: Just an ordinary office chair. That is all.
lines.只有奥罗金最精英阶层才能负担起得起这种复杂串珠风格所需的时间和费用。: Only the most elite of Orokin could afford the time, and expense, of this intricate beaded style.
lines.只有最敬业的研究者才能获得的饰物。有人说，它代表了古代神灵的眼睛，为换取智慧而牺: An ornament awarded only to the most dedicated of researchers. Said by some to be representative of the eye of an ancient deity, sacrificed in return for wisdom.
lines.召唤 Yareli 盘古底的忠实伙伴。: Call upon Yareli Pandea’s faithful companion.
lines.召唤一把充斥着纯洁光亮和无限力量的剑。: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
lines.召唤一把由纯粹的光与力量锻造而成的刀剑。: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
lines.召唤出一把强力长弓并发动毁灭性的集中箭矢射击。: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
lines.召唤巨人的力量。: Evoke the might of a giant.
lines.可以被用于金属切割或锉修。着陆器中的实用装备。: Can be used as metal-cutter or filer. A handy addition to any lander.
lines.可以装下时间公理考试所需的一切物品。: Carry everything you need for those Temporal Axioms exams.
lines.可以让孵化器繁殖库娃。: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
lines.可供替换的 Excalibur Prime 外观: An alternate body skin for Excalibur Prime
lines.可将这件银色且光滑的坠饰钩挂到任意近战锋刃上。: Hook these silvery sleek sugatra onto any blade.
lines.可怕的免疫血胞体，现在变成了一只可爱的毛茸茸玩偶。: The fearsome Hemocyte, now a cuddly floof.
lines.可进行强大的震地攻击的双足攻击者。该 Prex 卡牌的构思和插图由 Matias: Bipedal assailants capable of powerful ground slams. Prex designed and illustrated by Matias!
lines.可靠且经过改造，穿上索拉里斯护甲，你就能一路畅通无阻。: Repurposed and reliable, strap on Solaris armor and everything's green.
lines.史源绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条华丽的尾巴。: The Histornam Kaithe came into being with this regal tail.
lines.各种植物类物质会在 Helminth 的消化道内被处理、液化，剩余的残留物则会被: Plant-based materials of all kinds are processed and liquidized within the Helminth's digestive tract; the surplus is excreted as an inoffensive, inert clump.
lines.各类电子元器件。获取地点：金星，谷神星和赤毒要塞: Various electronic components. Location: Venus, Ceres, and the Kuva Fortress
lines.合一众信徒用来赞美 Ballas 的金色三线琴。: The golden Shawzin used by Narmer adherents to sing the praises of Ballas.
lines.吉拉演奏她的三线琴来振奋扎里曼船员的精神。她的歌声和记忆永存于虚空之中。: Kira played her shawzin to uplift the spirits of Zariman crewmembers. Her song and her memory live on in the Void.
lines.后置的虚空鳍片让鹦鹉螺保持稳定。: Rear-mounted Void fins keep the Nautilus stable.
lines.向 Tenno 的经典武器——螺钉步枪致敬的一枚纹章。: A Sigil honoring the Boltor, a Tenno classic.
lines.向双衍王境致敬的魂牵梦绕的徽章。: A haunting emblem paying homage to Duviri.
lines.向宇宙宣告你身上带着死亡的印记。: Proclaim to the cosmos that you bear the mark of death.
lines.向左转……向右转……开跳！: Turn to the left... turn to the right... dance!
lines.向远古的猎手们致敬。: An homage to hunters of the ancient past.
lines.听从指挥。消灭你的对手。恢复秩序。: Take command. Eliminate your adversaries. Restore order.
lines.呈现出一个能一口吞噬敌人的怪物形象。: Take on the look of a monster that can devour an enemy in a single bite.
lines.命运的低语在这个超凡的头环周围回荡。: Fateful whispers linger around this unearthly signa.
lines.和 Yareli 一起乘风破浪。饮料不包含在内。: Ride the waves with Yareli. Beverage not included.
lines.咖玛腕甲枪的这款冰霜外观使其不再只是工具。: This icy skin for the Gammacor elevates it even further beyond its origins as a mining tool.
lines.哈库那风格外观的寇恩热能枪，由头号 Grineer 武器制造商铸造。: A Harkonar styled Kohm, forged by the leading Grineer weapon manufacturer.
lines.哈库那风格外观的燃焰标枪，由头号 Grineer 武器制造商铸造。: A Harkonar styled Javlok, forged by the leading Grineer weapon manufacturer.
lines.哈库那风格外观的玛瑞火枪，由头号 Grineer 武器制造商铸造。: A Harkonar styled Marelok, forged by the leading Grineer weapon manufacturer.
lines.哈库那风格外观的葛恩火枪，由头号 Grineer 武器制造商铸造。: A Harkonar styled Grinlok, forged by the leading Grineer weapon manufacturer.
lines.唤起奥罗金时代永恒的古典主义，绘玉台是一个很不错的底座或桌子。: Evoking the timeless classicism of the Orokin era, the Kybus makes a great base or table.
lines.唯一比菌宝更可爱的就只有菌宝玩偶了。抱起来比真正的菌宝更令人爱不释手！: The only thing cuter than a Sprodling is a Sprodling floof. Even more cuddly than the real thing!
lines.唯有在战斗中证明了自身实力的 Grineer 才能挥舞炫耀这件坠饰。: Only Grineer who have proven their strength in combat can brandish these.
lines.唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于漂泊者。: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Drifter.
lines.唯有至崇宗师才可以使用这个表情动作。: Only the True Master may use this Emote.
lines.喉鱼的骨骼被 Ostron 人用来制作吊饰和工具。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的: The bones of the Mawfish are carved by the Ostron to produce ornaments and tools. Source: Cut from Mawfish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Mawfish in the Plains of Eidolon lake during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.喷射战锤的外观，由 Clyptic 设计。: A skin for the Jat Kittag mace, designed by Clyptic.
lines.回忆起处于两个真实面之间的地方。: Recalls the place that lies between two realities.
lines.因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在那里。: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
lines.因勤劳保育夜灵平野上的库阿卡、秃鹰和秋沙鸟而获得的奖励。: Awarded for the diligent preservation of the Kuakas, Condrocs and Mergoos of the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.因理绝灵骥是双衍王境最南端岛屿的本地物种。它们祖母绿色的眼眸曾经映照着它们踏过的: Aetigo Kaithes are a native species of Duviri's southernmost island. Their emerald eyes once reflected the verdant plains they roamed, but when the island was reduced to ash, their eyes faded to nothing.
lines.因理绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条气派的尾巴。: The Aetigo Kaithe came into being with this dignified tail.
lines.土星六号之狼在明亮背景下的浮印。: A glyph depicting the Wolf of Saturn Six on a bright background.
lines.土星六号之狼在黑暗背景下的浮印。: A glyph depicting the Wolf of Saturn Six on a dark background.
lines.圣使曲翼的默认外观。: Default skin for the Amesha Archwing.
lines.圣洁披饰会在 Tenno 每次使用技能的时候发出脉冲，并在每次使用技能时继续加强: The Sancti Syandana pulses every time the Tenno uses an ability and continues to strengthen with each ability used.
lines.在 90 秒内完成一个捕获任务: Finish a Capture mission in less than 90 seconds
lines.在 Maroo 的市集寻找 Maroo 的阿耶檀识宝物。: Look for Ayatan Treasures for Maroo in Maroo's Bazaar.
lines.在 Ostron 中的偏方被用来净化毒素。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露: Used in Ostron remedies to purify toxins. Source: Cut from Goopolla fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Goopolla in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.在《行动代号：猩红之矛》期间，通过在地面强袭任务中与 Sentient 谍影登陆: Earned through ground assaults against the Sentient Condrix during Operation Scarlet Spear.
lines.在《行动代号：猩红之矛》期间，通过在航道星舰突袭任务中与 Sentient 骨螺: Earned through Railjack raids against the Sentient Murex during Operation Scarlet Spear.
lines.在「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间，虚空在这个进化的饰冠上留下了印记。: The Void left its mark on this evolving Sekhara during the Zariman Void Jump.
lines.在「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间，虚空在这个进化的饰冠上留下了印记。装备这个饰冠并: The Void left its mark on this evolving Sekhara during the Zariman Void Jump. Defeat enemies as the Operator with this Sekhara equipped and unlock an additional look.
The Void left its mark on this evolving Sekhara during the Zariman Void Jump. Defeat enemies as the Operator with this Sekhara equipped and unlock two additional looks.
lines.在一个充满荣誉的地方展示你的魔典。: Display your Grimoire in a place of honor.

lines.在一个熟悉的「扎里曼号」船舱架子上发现的一张全家福，它可能会勾起一些回忆。: A family portrait found on a shelf in a familiar Zariman cabin, it may stir memories.
lines.在一场精彩的湿创对战后，没有什么比悠然欣赏日落更惬意的了。: There’s nothing like kicking back and enjoying the sunset after a good Soaktron battle.
lines.在一次与她照顾的孩子发生的悲惨事故中失明后，Margulis 将疤痕视为骄傲的勋: After being blinded in a tragic accident with one of her charges, Margulis wore the scars as a badge of pride, never turning her back on her beloved children.
lines.在一片雪花飘落的云朵下化作冬日之心。: Become the heart of the winter, beneath a cloud of falling snow.
lines.在上古之战高峰期间，Tenno 的突袭者会使用这些火焰般的坠饰来威吓并使敌人分心: During the height of the Old War, Tenno raiders used these flaming sugatras to intimidate and distract enemies.
lines.在严寒、酷暑和灌木丛中行军时，柔软的保护层会是一个优势。: A soft protective layer is an advantage during long marches through cold, heat, and underbrush.
lines.在享用矿物质时，Helminth 会把那些未被完全吸收的矿物质转化为光滑浓郁、并: On consuming minerals, Helminth converts those it does not fully absorb into a smooth, rich paste with a faint vanilla odor.
lines.在人群中以这件 Ki'Teer 的原型脱颖而出。: Stand apart from the crowd with this Ki'Teer original.
lines.在仲裁之中，死亡阴影隐现之处，生命之火燃得最旺。这座光的雕塑致敬了那种求生的精神: In Arbitrations, where death’s shadow looms, life’s fire burns brightest. This light sculpture is a tribute to that survival.
lines.在任务中设置一枚浮印。: Deploy a Glyph while on a mission.
lines.在任务中部署一个空中支援呼叫器: Deploy an Air Support Charge in a Mission
lines.在你捍卫重要之物时，穿上这件坚不可摧的奥罗金护甲，你会赢得敬畏。: Command fear and respect as you safeguard what matters most, clad in this indomitable Orokin armor.
lines.在你的街机游戏上游玩《奥利的极速赛道》。街机游戏可以从中继站上的中枢 Simar: Play Ollie's Crash Course on your Ludoplex. A Ludoplex may be acquired from Cephalon Simaris on a relay.
lines.在你的街机游戏上游玩《火力女兵 2》。街机游戏可以从中继站上的中枢 Simari: Play Caliber Chicks 2 on your Ludoplex. A Ludoplex may be acquired from Cephalon Simaris on a relay.
lines.在你身后留下一道芬芳花瓣的足迹。: Leave a trail of fragrant petals in your wake.
lines.在你身后留下一道萤火虫和树叶的足迹。: Leave a trail of fireflies and forest leaves in your wake.
lines.在充满了科腐者的霍瓦尼亚商场地底模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最: Simulate a battle in a Techrot-choked Mall beneath Höllvania. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.在单个耳机凸显了迷人的设计。: An enchanting design accentuated by a single earpiece.
lines.在单次任务中防御两个镜像防御目标各 3 次。: Defend both Mirror Defense objectives 3 times each in a single mission.
lines.在单次弓箭射击中射穿并杀死 2 名以上的敌人。: Pierce and kill 2 or more enemies in a single Bow shot.
lines.在圣所幻影装置中模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。: Simulate a battle in the Sanctum Anatomica. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.在多种甲板和污水池中常见，这种架子使得许多常用工具和零件触手可及。放置在引擎室中: A common sight on various decks and in the sumps, these racks allow much-needed tools and parts to remain within arm's reach. A tasteful addition to any engine room.
lines.在夜灵平野上击杀一个巨牙重击者: Kill a Tusk Thumper in the Plains of Eidolon
lines.在夜灵平野上击杀一个巨牙重击者朵玛: Kill a Tusk Thumper Doma in the Plains of Eidolon
lines.在奥罗金帝国衰败之前，只有最高阶的奥罗金将领才能被授予凯旋将军披饰。: Before the fall, the Imperator Syandana was bestowed upon only the highest-ranking Orokin commanders.
lines.在奥罗金时代，只有最凶猛的战士们才被准许穿戴这件火焰般的披饰: During the Orokin Era, only the most fierce warriors were permitted to wear this flaming Syandana.
lines.在奥罗金时代，那些带着这个标志的人令人钦佩又恐惧。装饰在奥罗金政治暗杀学院毕业学: During the Orokin era, those who bore this symbol inspired both admiration and fear. The jewel that adorned the Scoria, alumnae of the Orokin school of political assassination, is now yours to wear. Details of the school's ethos can be found in Ash's section of the Leverian.
lines.在奥罗金遗迹中模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。: Simulate a battle inside an Orokin Derelict. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
lines.在德枢·莱弗讲述的故事中，力欧·德纳斯在 Ash 受命而来时使用了这把手枪自卫；: This skin immortalizes the pistol Lio De Nas used in self-defense when Ash came calling, in the story told by Drusus Leverian.
lines.在您的战甲上包覆这个古老的战斗装束，能将恐惧深深地烙近到敌人的内心之中。: Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies by cladding your Warframe in this ancient battle attire.
lines.在战争的泥沼中繁茂生长。: Flourish out of the muddiness of war.
lines.在战斗的烟尘中冉冉升起的全新 Ember。: From the ashes of battle a flamboyant new Ember rises.
lines.在战甲没有受到伤害的情况下清除一批登上航道星舰的敌人。: Clear a Railjack Boarding Party without your Warframe taking damage
lines.在所有拳套上使用这个节庆外观来一路响叮当吧！: Jingle all the way with this festive skin for any fist weapon.
lines.在敌人的地形上模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。: Simulate a battle on your foe's terrain. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.在敌人的生命精华中徜徉。: Bathe in the life essence of your enemies.
lines.在敌人的竞技场中上演一场战斗，深入了解他们的战术。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超: Stage a battle in your enemy's arena for deeper insight into their tactics. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.在整个魔胎之境，没有一个生物在萌动，甚至连一只扑猎达赛都没有。: All through the Drift, not a creature was stirring, not even a Predasite.
lines.在月球的光辉下模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。: Simulate a battle under the light of Lua. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.在此设备上游玩始源星系中最精彩的游戏。已预装战甲霸王。: Play the finest games in the Origin System with this device. Comes pre-installed with Frame Fighter.
lines.在武形秘仪中以刀剑和星镖奋勇交战的骄傲象征。: A symbol of pride for those that braved blade and star in The Conclave.
lines.在火卫二的魔胎之境中完成一个隔离库赏金任务。: Complete an Isolation Vault Bounty Mission in the Cambion Drift on Deimos.
lines.在熔岩和火山之火的美丽中不朽的传承。: A legacy immortalized in the beauty of molten rock and volcanic fire.
lines.在空中挥动你的手臂，就像你准备好扔出套索一样。: Swing your arm in the air like you’re ready to snare.
lines.在结合仪式中所有的东西或许都是已知的，猎者。这是一个可以装点你轨道飞行器的失效的: In Synthesis all things may be known, Hunter. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
lines.在脸部周围有独特印记的毛皮花纹。: A fur pattern with distinctive marking around the face.
lines.在苦难中诞生的尊贵传承。: A regal legacy born from torment.
lines.在萃取过程中能被冷却液稀释的液态岩浆。在热爆过程中，热美亚会出现在奥布山谷表面，: A magma like liquid that is diluted with coolant during the extraction process. Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups. Could this be the key to weakening the Exploiter Orb's defenses? Location: Thermia Fractures event in the Orb Vallis on Venus
lines.在血色面纱的庇护下磨炼你的战斗技能。此模拟允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25: Hone your combat skills under the auspices of the Red Veil. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.在赤毒生存任务中生存超过 20 分钟。: Survive for over 20 minutes in Kuva Survival.
lines.在身体被时间与疾病给折磨到残破不堪以前，优雅的大女皇曾穿着这件斗篷。: Once worn by an elegant Elder Queen, before time and disease left her body mangled and disfigured.
lines.在轨道飞行器强化 Helminth，并解锁将新技能转移到战甲上的功能。: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
lines.在这个变图展示图中，现实仅仅是一种视角，它展现了现实与可能之间的冲突。: Reality is merely a point of view in this lenticular display illustrating the conflict between what is and what could have been.
lines.在这个独一无二的护甲中有能迷住旁观者的涡旋虚空能量。: Mesmerize onlookers with swirling Void energy embedded in this exclusive armor.
lines.在这件坠饰中，优雅的灵蛇如同神圣的绳索盘绕在金饰上。: In this Sugatra, the elegant serpent weaves itself through gold like a sacred cord.
lines.在这件外观下，你的守护将与德枢·莱弗所描述的围绕在古老阿尔特拉塔的空中哨兵一样难: In this skin, your Sentinel will be indistinguishable from the air sentries that surrounded the ancient tower of Altra, as described by Drusus Leverian.
lines.在这件宠物华丽外观的作用下，薇娜丽化身成了阴暗且又危险的森林。: Venari becomes the dark and dangerous woods in this deluxe pet skin.
lines.在这场斗牛挑战赛中挑选一名战甲与所有的挑战者一决高下。: Pick a Warframe and square off against all contenders in this mano-a-mano challenge.
lines.在这幅由神秘的景幕大师拉夫·塞格拉斯设计的惊世之作中，玫瑰色的朦胧微光照耀着一个: A rosy nebulous light illuminates an impossible landscape in this stunning work by enigmatic Vistagraph master, Raff Seglass.
lines.在这张动态海报中，火卫二上的纯种恶棍加弗 & 拉托罗首次合体。: Together for the first time in this dynamic poster, the original bad dudes of Deimos, Garv & Latrox.
lines.在这款以冰为主题的披饰中，参差不齐的冰晶尖刺外笼罩着一层雪雾。: Jagged, crystalline spikes crown a shroud of snowy mist in this ice themed syandana.
lines.在这款优雅的双持匕首外观，精美手工艺与致命杀伤力双剑合壁。: Artistry meets lethality with this elegant dual dagger skin.
lines.在遥远的过去，这种手枪杀伤力巨大。: In the distant past, pistols of this kind packed a mean punch.
lines.在金色中永生，Ballas 最强大禁卫的标志: Immortalized in gold, the insignia of Ballas' greatest Dax
lines.在钢铁之路中击败奥金魇龙: Defeat the Orowyrm in Steel Path
lines.在限定时间内，为你的轨道飞行器添加各种节庆装饰吧！: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!
lines.在雷霆的允诺和威力下飘摇吧，这个积云披饰是为那些住在云间的 Tenno 们所设计: Roiling and swirling with the promise and threat of a thunderhead, the Cumulus Syandana is for those Tenno who dwell among the clouds.
lines.在霍瓦尼亚后巷中模拟战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25 级。: Simulate a battle in the back-alleys of Höllvania. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.在饱受折磨的心灵深处模拟一场战斗。该幻影装置允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 2: Simulate a battle in the deepest depths of a tormented mind. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.均衡仲裁者的浮印: A glyph of the Arbiters of Hexis
lines.均衡仲裁者集团的勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。: Medallion of the Arbiters of Hexis syndicate. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
lines.坚不可摧的一口井，里面带有慧珠。: An unbreakable well containing Saggen Pearls.
