lines.坚不可摧的伊莱体构造复制品。: An unbreakable replica of an Iradite formation.
lines.坚不可摧的分形沉积物，不含任何密印髓质。: An unbreakable fractal deposit containing no Rune Marrow.
lines.坚不可摧的原型感染肉块复制品。: An unbreakable replica of a proto-infested clump.
lines.坚不可摧的备用实验性电弧继电器复制品。: An unbreakable replica of an experimental Arc-Relay reserve.
lines.坚不可摧的晶化突岩复制品。: An unbreakable replica of a vitrific outcrop.
lines.坚不可摧的桶，用于盛放葛克度。: An unbreakable drum used to contain Grokdrul.
lines.坚不可摧的科腐者主板堆复制品。: An unbreakable replica of a Techrot motherboard cluster.
lines.坚不可摧的艾弗旺样本储备。: An unbreakable stockpile of Efervon samples.
lines.坚不可摧的龙涎结晶分形矿藏。: An unbreakable fractal deposit of Aggristone.
lines.坚固的装备，已被漂泊者穿得破破烂烂。: Rugged gear, worn ragged by The Drifter.
lines.坚韧不拔的火力女兵竟然可以是个暖心玩偶。: This tough-as-nails Caliber Chick makes for a surprisingly snuggly floof.
lines.埃莉诺·南丁格尔是六人组中神秘的精神专家，她为 Nyx 战甲带来了人性化的一面。: Eleanor Nightingale, the mysterious psychic specialist of the Hex, brings a human face to the Nyx Warframe. Switch between Nyx and Eleanor's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Eleanor Gemini Emote, even during missions.
lines.埃莉诺的可爱复制品，保证不会钻入你的脑袋，也不会对你露出尖牙。: Eleanor's cuddly replica, guaranteed not to get in your head or bare her fangs at you.
lines.埃莉诺的标志性飘逸长发，紧紧束起。: Eleanor's signature flowing locks, tightly bound up.
lines.基于早期的实验设计，采用感染者骨肉作为外壳，这件外观让你的殁世机甲更加可怕。: Make your Necramech even more fearsome with this skin, based on early experimental designs that employed outer casings of Infested bone and meat.
lines.基于早期的实验设计，采用感染者骨肉作为外壳，这件头盔让你的殁世机甲更加可怕。: Make your Necramech even more fearsome with this helmet, based on early experimental designs that employed outer casings of Infested bone and meat.
lines.基于标准配置的西格玛系列原型升级的反应堆。: An upgraded reactor based on the standard issue Sigma series original.
lines.基于瑞圣途的孩子们曾携带的长枪制作，这些武器当时是以 Nezha 的圣火尖枪为原: Based on the spears carried by the Children of Reshantur, which were in turn modeled on Nezha's flaming spears.
lines.塔克桑守护使用的沙漠伪装外观。: Desert camouflage skin for the Taxon Sentinel.
lines.塔克桑的护盾恢复可能意味着生死之间的分界。这款节日外观就体现了这一点。: The Taxon’s shield restoration could mean the difference between life and death. This festive skin illustrates both.
lines.塔克桑的标准外观配置。: The standard issue skin for the Taxon Sentinel.
lines.墙中人微笑的浮印，由 death_ma666ots 创作。: A glyph depicting the smile of the Man in the Wall, designed by death_ma666ots.
lines.士魂大帝勉强允许他的公民使用这些屏风来维护个人的隐私。有些地方即使是他那双尊贵的: Thrax has, grudgingly, allowed his citizens the use of these screens for the preservation of personal modesty. There are some places where even his exalted eyes have no business peering.
lines.备受追捧的精制棱柱形殁世烯。火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。: A prismatic refinement of raw Necrathene, highly sought after. Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.
lines.复斓马盔让人想起双衍王境中千变万化的色调。: The Irdeni Chamfron is reminiscent of the ever-changing hues in Duviri’s sky.
lines.外表已破裂，而你已看见真相。: The facade has cracked and you are beheld by the truth.
lines.外部化的活体连接器硬件和由此产生的面部标记，由远古之战时期的工匠制作而成。: Externalized Somatic Link hardware and resulting facial markings crafted by artisans in the time of The Old War.
lines.多少护甲才算过量？对于 Grendel 暴坦的标志性胸甲来说，越多越好。: How much armor is too much armor? With Grendel Turbis' signature chestplate, more is more.
lines.夜帽在深矿中发现的某种奇特的奥罗金花哨装置。: Some sort of fancy Orokin wizbang that Nightcap found buried in the Deepmines.
lines.够带劲的披饰，像 Hildryn 一样强壮。: A Syandana with kick, as robust as Hildryn herself.
lines.大地震颤，宣告你的到来。Grendel 暴坦的标志性幻纹。: The ground trembles to herald your arrival. Grendel Turbis' signature ephemera.
lines.大家最爱的男团的人形立牌。: A cardboard cut-out of everyone's favorite boy band.
lines.大胆，粗犷，坚定。夜晚而立，面朝黎明。: Bold, rugged, stalwart. Stand the night, face the dawn.
lines.大自然最残暴的一面生动体现在这件库娃华丽外观上。: Nature at its most brutal comes alive in this deluxe skin for your Kavat.
lines.大蛇之牙蕴含着毁灭。: Doom in the sting of a serpent’s tooth.
lines.天才的凌乱丸子头，因为有更重要的事要操心。: The messy bun of a genius with far more important things to worry about.
lines.太阳在胜利者上升起，在被征服者身上落下。这就是你传说的诞生之处。用这个精致的披饰: The sun rises on the victor and sets upon the vanquished. This is how your legend is made. Adorn yourself with this exquisite syandana, worthy of the sun herself.
lines.头发不过是虚荣的象征。里昂的标志性发型堪称极致的免打理之选。: Hair is vanity. Lyon’s signature style is the ultimate in low maintenance.
lines.头戴这件灵感来自丑角的头盔，Mirage 总能笑到最后。: With this Harlequin-inspired helm, Mirage always has the last laugh.
lines.奈富·安尤在 Mashed Warframe MV 中的浮印。: A Glyph depicting Nef Anyo from the Mashed Warframe music video.
lines.奉陛下士魂大帝之圣令，所有人都将会度过一个快乐的 Tennobaum。: By royal order of his majesty Dominus Thrax, all shall have a merry Tennobaum.
lines.奖励给在泰斯拉末日活动里表现杰出的 Tenno 的徽章: An insignia awarded to the Tenno who distinguished themselves during Tethra's Doom event.
lines.奖励给旧全球排行榜上获得金牌的 Tenno。: Awarded to Tenno who achieved a Gold Rank on the retired Global Leaderboards.
lines.奖励给旧全球排行榜上获得铜牌的 Tenno。: Awarded to Tenno who achieved a Bronze Rank on the retired Global Leaderboards.
lines.奖励给旧全球排行榜上获得银牌的 Tenno。: Awarded to Tenno who achieved a Silver Rank on the retired Global Leaderboards.
lines.奖励给莲的所有忠诚追随者们。: Awarded to Tenno recruited by an ally of The Lotus.
lines.奖励给那些参与了最佳宣传片比赛的 Tenno。: Participatory prize for the Tenno's Greatest Trailer contest.
lines.奖励给那些在 TennoCon 2019 中解锁圣殿展览最终等级的玩家。: Awarded for unlocking final tier in the Sanctuary Showcase gameshow at TennoCon 2019.
lines.奖励给那些在 TennoCon 2021 艺术展中优胜的决赛选手！: Awarded to the Featured Finalists of the TennoCon 2021 Art Show!
lines.奖励给那些在 TennoCon 2022 艺术展中优胜的决赛选手！: Awarded to the Featured Finalists of the TennoCon 2022 Art Show!
lines.奖励给那些在《行动代号：猩红之矛》中有着突出表现的玩家。: Awarded for exemplary performance in Operation Scarlet Spear.
lines.奖励给那些在永冻晶矿前线活动中做出贡献的 Tenno。: Awarded to Tenno for their contribution to the Cryotic Front event.
lines.奖励给那些通过帮助其他 Tenno 来协助 Lotus 的 Tenno。: Awarded to Tenno who assist the Lotus by helping other Tenno.
lines.奖励那些参与 Tenno Live 2015 活动的玩家。: Awarded to players who attended the Tenno Live 2015.
lines.奥克绪罗斯的标准外观配置。: The standard issue skin for the Oxylus Sentinel.
lines.奥堤克光子枪的闪电迷彩外观。: The Shock-Camo skin for the Opticor.
lines.奥席金属产于奥罗金，是一种比空气还轻的稀有合金，被用于部分 Corpus 机器人: Oxium is a rare lighter than air alloy of Orokin origin, used in certain Corpus Robotics. Location: Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Neptune, Pluto, Eris, Europa, and Lua.
lines.奥比克斯的闪电迷彩外观。: The Shock-Camo skin for the Obex.
lines.奥罗金军事称号，授予在战斗中表现英勇无畏的人。: Orokin military title, awarded to recognize acts of exceptional heroism in battle.
lines.奥罗金哲士仪器既是身份象征，也是研究工具。: Orokin archimedean instruments were status symbols as well as tools of study.
lines.奥罗金基础设施运作中使用的镀金组件。: A gilded component used in the operation of Orokin infrastructure.
lines.奥罗金时代流传下来的的远古能量电池。获取地点：谷神星，土星和火卫二: Ancient energy cell from the Orokin era. Location: Ceres, Saturn, and Deimos
lines.奥罗金时代用来纪念特别忠诚的库狛的项圈。: A collar used to honor especially loyal Kubrows in the Orokin era.
lines.奥罗金的斗士可以配戴这枚纹章以证明他们的忠诚。: Champions of the Orokin were allowed to wear this Sigil as proof of their loyalty.
lines.奥罗金陶瓷艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆采用旧世界的上釉技术为这个盘子赋予光泽。当时的精英: Orokin ceramic artist, Bren Terrasiam employed an old world glazing technique to give this plate a lustrous finish. Elites of the day admired his mastery of the ancient arts.
lines.女巫维纳从一个注定毁灭的未来中现身，向 Garuda 露出残忍的笑容。尽情沉溺于: Vena, the Wytch, emerges from a doomed future to put a sadistic smile on Garuda. Revel in the blood of all those who stand against her.
lines.她正在列出一张赏金任务的清单，并反复对其检查。: She’s making a list of Bounties and checking it twice.
lines.好友间互相表达问候的经典表现。你还知道那些少见的握手方法吗？: A classic means for friends to exchange greetings. Do you know any secret handshakes?
lines.如一个遥远太阳的光芒般抑郁且漂亮，以希利亚护甲是一个穿梭于世界之间并居无定所的旅: As melancholy and beautiful as the glow of a distant sun, Etheria Armor is the suitable accoutrement for a traveler between worlds who is resident of none. A signature set of armor for Harrow Reliquary.
lines.如影随形地潜入战场。: Slip into battle like a shadow.
lines.如早上的第一道晨光，这把三线琴会唤醒内在的灵魂。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来: Like the morning’s first light, this Shawzin will wake the spirit within. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
lines.如果双衍王境的民选政府真实存在，那么一定用的是这种风格的座椅。: The style of chair that would be occupied by Duviri’s elected government, if it had one.
lines.如果是 Sentient 创造了 Volt，他就会是这个样子。: Volt as he would have been, had the Sentients created him.
lines.如果能同时身处两地，许多问题便迎刃而解。但这种能力同时也带来了许多其他问题。微弱: Many problems can be solved by the ability to be in two places at once. Many other problems are created this way. Faint traces of Efervon imply the artist may have had a mechanical hand.
lines.如果鞋子合脚，就展示出来。: If the shoe fits, display it.
lines.如欲撼动山脉，仅需自身化作山。用这标志性外观来体现 Atlas 的地动之力。: To move a mountain, become the mountain. Embody the tectonic power of Atlas with this landmark skin.
lines.如燃烧的陨星一般从天界降临，击溃胆敢挑战之人。: Descend from the heavens like a burning star to smite all challengers.
lines.如莲花绽放般抽出你的剑。: Unsheath your sword like a lotus in bloom.
lines.娇艳的花朵被恶毒的荆棘衬托，警示着：美丽也可能致命。Citrine 美神的标志性: Delicate blooms framed by vicious thorns warn: beauty can still be deadly. Citrine Aphrodita’s signature syandana.
lines.娴熟运用灭骸之刃的演示。: A display of finesse with the Parazon.
lines.嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
lines.孤傲的战士，独行于族群唯有月雾蝠，常伴其左右眼神若冰霜，内心亦朦胧化身为恐惧，死: A warrior walks, alone in crowds Companion to moon and mist and bat With a vision grim the mind enshrouds This fearsome, deathborne aristocrat.
lines.孤寂三线琴的每一次弹奏都会响起一个创造性的灵魂。: A creative soul rings out with each strum of the Lonesome Shawzin.
lines.它曾经是 Sentient 防御技术的最新成果，如今已成为所有 Tenno 的点: Once the latest in Sentient defensive technology, now an embellishment for any Tenno.
lines.宇宙间的光与暗蚀刻在了这款星察登陆艇外观上。: The light and dark of the cosmos are etched into this skin for the Parallax Landing Craft.
lines.守护宠物的尾部配件。: A tail attachment for your Sentinel pet.
lines.守护宠物的时髦尾部配件。: A stylish tail attachment for your sentinel pet.
lines.守护宠物的飞翼配件。: A wings attachment for your Sentinel pet.
lines.守护宠物色彩鲜艳的一对飞翼。: Brightly painted wings for your sentinel pet.
lines.守护宠物色彩鲜艳的尾羽。: Brightly painted tail feathers for your sentinel pet.
lines.守护宠物色彩鲜艳的骷髅面具配件。: A brightly painted skull mask attachment for your sentinel pet.
lines.守护者——亚克什的优雅肖像。: An elegant portrait of Raksh, the defender.
lines.守护蛟龙的次世代外观。: This is a next-generation skin for the Wyrm sentinel.
lines.守护赫利俄斯的次世代外观。: This is a next-generation skin for the Helios sentinel.
lines.守望者的武器设计优胜者外观，由 Rekkou 设计。: A prize-winning skin for the Vectis, designed by Rekkou.
lines.守望者的武器设计优胜者外观，由 StratoS117 设计。: A prize-winning skin for the Vectis, designed by StratoS117.
lines.安尤企业的一张本月最佳员工的签名照片。: An autographed photo of the Employee of the Month, at Anyo Corp.
lines.完成 TennoCon 2019 游戏活动的玩家所得到的奖励。: Given to those who complete the TennoCon 2019 game activity.
lines.完成一场至少 12 波的防御任务。: Complete a Defense mission reaching at least Wave 12.
lines.完成一场至少 20 分钟的生存任务。: Complete a Survival mission reaching at least 20 minutes.
lines.完成一次深层科研或时光科研: Complete a run of Deep Archimedea or Temporal Archimedea
lines.官方授权的 Baro Ki'Teer K 式悬浮板涂鸦！孩子们，今天就来获取吧！: Officially-licensed Baro Ki'Teer K-Drive Scrawl! Get yours today, kids!
lines.宛如蝴蝶的翅膀破蛹而出，这款披饰似乎被注入了神秘的力量。: Resembling a butterfly's wings emerging from their chrysalis, this Syandana seems infused with mystical power.
lines.实验性的电涡幽灵技术催生了许多令人好奇的校准器和色散探头。: Experimental Vortengeist technology spawned many curious calibrators and dispersion probes.
lines.宽阔的曲线是尼迪纳护甲套装的精髓。: Broad swooping curves are the essence of the Nidina armor set.
lines.对于一个内心充满痛苦的人来说，王座也可以是牢笼。: To one damned within his own mind, a throne can be a prison.
lines.对于某些受青睐的 Tenno 来说，弗莱尔的感染吉他已同意像其他乐器一样被演奏。: For some favored Tenno, Flare's infested guitar has consented to be played like any other instrument. Handle with respect - and caution.
lines.对信心和权威的展现。: A display of confidence and authority.
lines.对殁世械灵爱不释手？那就把这版毛绒绒的、不会说话的他带回家吧。: Can't get enough of Necraloid? Bring home this cuddly, and silent, version.
lines.封存在水晶中的贝里克和拉尼娅，这对恋人的记忆。: A memory of the lovers, Belric and Rania, preserved in crystal.

lines.将 Baruuk 冥想能量曼陀罗的宁静赐予你的轨道飞行器。: Bestow the serenity of Baruuk’s meditative energy mandala upon your orbiter.
lines.将 Corpus 风格融入你的刀剑中。: Appropriate the Corpus aesthetic for your blade.
lines.将 Jordas 魔像的碎片佩戴在身上，作为击败他的战利品。: A fragment of the Jordas Golem worn as a trophy by those who defeated him.
lines.将 Tenno 的特能与 Sentient 设计融为一体的 Tauron 学院制: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
lines.将任何战锤类武器改变为锻钢的外观。: Transform any Hammer weapon with this forged steel skin.
lines.将任意双持手枪转换为巴洛克式的左轮手枪外观。: Transform any dual pistol with this baroque revolver skin.
lines.将任意手枪转换为巴洛克式的左轮手枪外观。: Transform any pistol with this baroque revolver skin.
lines.将传统 Mod 变成艺术品。墨染 Mod。在一个中继站找到见习仲裁者左巴即可制作: Turns a conventional mod into a work of art. An Atragraph Mod. Find Aspirant Zorba on a relay to create Atragraph Mods.
lines.将你的 K 式悬浮板转换为一只白色迅敏节虫。: Transforms your K-Drive in to a White Velocipod.
lines.将你的 K 式悬浮板转换为一只紫色迅敏节虫。: Transforms your K-Drive in to a Purple Velocipod.
lines.将你的 K 式悬浮板转换为一只绿色迅敏节虫。: Transforms your K-Drive in to a Green Velocipod.
lines.将你的登陆艇改造成与追猎者完美匹配的样子。: Transform your Landing Craft into a perfect match for Stalker’s.
lines.将侍刃跨右肩背在身上。: Nikanas are holstered across the right shoulder.
lines.将侍刃跨左肩背在身上。: Nikanas are holstered across the left shoulder.
lines.将勇气铭记于心伴随你前行的每一步。Styanax 的精英头盔。: Remember your courage with each step. An elite helmet for Styanax.
lines.将匕首武器收纳于左腰。: Daggers are holstered at the left hip.
lines.将双刀武器分别收纳至肩膀两侧。: Dual Blades are holstered on each shoulder.
lines.将双刀武器收纳至后腰。: Dual Blades are holstered at the hips.
lines.将双截棍跨右肩背在身上。: Nunchakus are holstered across the right shoulder.
lines.将双截棍跨左肩背在身上。: Nunchakus are holstered at the left hip.
lines.将巨剑武器背在腰际之处。: Greatswords are holstered at the hips.
lines.将巨剑跨右肩背在身上。: Greatswords are holstered across the right shoulder.
lines.将战刃武器收纳于后背上方。: Glaives are holstered on the upper back.
lines.将战斗的混乱转化为金子般的胜利。: Transmute the chaos of battle into golden triumph.
lines.将拐刃反向收纳在肩膀上。: Tonfas are holstered on opposite shoulders.
lines.将拐刃收纳于腰间。: Tonfas are holstered at the hips.
lines.将枪刃武器收纳在后腰处。: Gunblades are holstered across the lower back.

lines.将枪刃武器收纳至左腰处。: Gunblades are holstered at the left hip.
lines.将棍棒收纳于左肩。: Staffs are holstered on the left shoulder.
lines.将棍棒武器跨肩收纳在背后。: Staffs are holstered across the lower back.
lines.将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用军械库功能。: Install this segment in order to enable the Arsenal within your orbiter.
lines.将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用宠物孵化器功能。: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.
lines.将此模块安装在轨道飞行器的 Mod 终端机上以解锁 Mod 融铸功能。: Install this segment to enable the Mod Fusion function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.
lines.将此虚空遗物模块安装到你的轨道飞行器上，即可开启虚空遗物。虚空遗物内含的宝物只有: Install this Void Relic Segment in your Orbiter to begin opening Void Relics. Void Relics contain valuables that are only determined when opened in Void Fissure missions. Void Relics can be obtained as mission rewards.
lines.将洛德笔下的斐波那契素描呈现为浮印，供大家欣赏。: Present Loid's Fibonacci sketch as a Glyph for all to see.
lines.将洛德笔下的标弃素描呈现为浮印，供大家欣赏。: Present Loid's Tagfer sketch as a Glyph for all to see.
lines.将生物群落的收成转化为营养块的便利设备。: Turn biome harvests into nutrition cubes with this handy appliance.
lines.将直剑收纳在右腰侧。: Swords are holstered at the right hip.
lines.将直剑收纳在左腰侧。: Swords are holstered at the left hip.
lines.将细剑武器跨肩收纳于后背上方。: Rapiers are holstered across the upper back.
lines.将自己裹入这款由天然丝绸所启发联想到的披饰。: Envelop yourself in this silky nature-inspired syandana.
lines.将营养块制成美味的冰沙和汤品。: Blend nutrition cubes into delicious smoothies and soups.
lines.将轨道飞行器的铸造厂升级，可获得下列功能： －可以制造登陆艇 －可以制造空中支持: Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features: - Allows construction of Landing Craft - Allows construction of Air Support Charges Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
lines.将这个小祈运坛放置在你的轨道飞行器中并邀请 Koumei 来指引你的命运。: Place this small shrine in your Orbiter and invite Koumei to guide your destiny.
lines.将这些星星置入阿耶檀识塑像之中为其提供动力。也可以作为内融核心的来源。: Place these stars into Ayatan Sculptures to power their movement. May also be a source of Endo.
lines.将这位电子舞者打扮成一种形态，唤起对往日那个科学界充满狂野与危险的年代中阀门与电: Garb the electrical dancer in a form evoking the valves and cables of years past, when science was wild and dangerous.
lines.将这张海报挂在墙上，以纪念深矿中的无名英雄。: Hang this poster on your wall to honor the unsung heroes of the Deepmines.
lines.将这款奇特的披饰摆在醒目位置。: Put on a striking display with this fanciful syandana.
lines.将这种物质磨成粉末可以短暂使得火烧得更旺。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露: Ground into a powder this substance can makes fires burn hotter for a brief amount of time. Source: Cut from Karkina fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Karkina in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.将重武器收纳至右腰处。: Heavy weapons are holstered at the right hip.
lines.将重武器收纳至左腰处。: Heavy weapons are holstered at the left hip.
lines.将重武器背在后腰处。: Heavy weapons are holstered across the lower back.
lines.尊贵祝福农历蛇年，辞旧迎新。: A noble reminder of Lunar Renewal.
lines.尊贵祝福农历龙年，辞旧迎新。: A noble reminder of Lunar Renewal.
lines.小心别踩到这种尖锐如长矛般的蘑菇伞盖。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。获取: Avoid stepping on this sharp, spear-like mushroom cap. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information. Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
lines.尖幡的次世代外观。: A next-generation look for the Pennant.
lines.尚武、庄严、凶恶。这张脸将恐惧植入每个敌人心间。: Martial. Regal. Malevolent. A face to foster fear in all foes.
lines.尝试通过这款标志性的原子摩托车涂装变得和奥利一样酷吧。: Just try to be as cool as Ollie with this signature Atomicycle livery.
lines.就像一朵肉食性的花一样，这件披饰的诱人外表下潜藏着一个危险的捕食者。: Like a carnivorous flower, this alluring Syandana conceals a dangerous predator.
lines.就像为基利安带来力量的无人机一样！ 免责声明：仅用于娱乐目的。实际功能仅限于清洁: Just like the drone that supplies the Killians with power ups! Disclaimer: For entertainment purposes only. Actual functionality limited to cleaning, unit will not provide power ups.
lines.就目前而已，外分泌液蛋奶酒实验是一场灾难性的失败……: Exocrine Nog experiments were a catastrophic failure...for now.
lines.尼迪纳护甲套装流畅的曲线，现在以冰雪风格重新演绎。: The swooping curves of the Nidina armor set, now rendered in icy style.
lines.尽管虚空无情之物的影响日益增强，但不屈头环的进化证明了你的反抗精神也在以同样的力: Though the influence of the Indifference grows stronger, this evolution of the Invictus signa proves that your defiance grows in equal measure.
lines.展开的双翼揭示了通往天外位面之径。: Outstretched wings reveal the path to celestial planes.
lines.展现一位足智多谋的战士的勇气。: Show the grit of a resourceful warrior.
lines.展现了天使之翼的威严。: Take on the majesty of an angel’s wings.

lines.展现你冷酷的怒火与冰冷的决心。: Declare your cold fury and icy determination.

lines.殁世械灵坚持采用古老且可靠的英择谛技术，而不是任何更先进的技术。: Necraloids insist upon using archaic but reliable Entrati technology, in preference to anything more modern.
lines.殁世械灵引以为傲的是，他们的浮雕勋章项圈始终保持干净光洁，就像他们还活着的时候一: Necraloids take pride in keeping their medallion-embossed collars as clean and polished as they did when they were living servants.
lines.殖民者曾被发现利用它来隐藏被严禁使用的拉基饮品，导致更多的检查。: Colonists were once caught concealing the forbidden Raaki juice within, leading to more inspections.
lines.每一小瓶是由数十亿罕见的，栖息于海底喷管附近的微生物所制造的。获取地点：午夜电波: Each vial is produced by the painstaking expression of billions of rare, ocean-vent dwelling microorganisms. Location: Nightwave Cred Offerings
lines.每一次攻击都证明巨蛇既是创造者，也是毁灭者。: Each strike proves that the serpent is both creator and destroyer.
lines.每一种双衍王境鱼类都具有与众不同的特征，但它们都进化产生了美丽的彩色鳞片。获取地: Each Duviri fish species has distinct features, but they all evolved beautiful chromatic scales. Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
lines.每次以结合扫描器执行扫描时，有几率进行二次扫描。: Chance for each scan with the Synthesis Scanner to count as two scans.
lines.比睡在地上强，但也好不了多少。: Better than the ground, but not by much.
lines.毫不留情的侵略与坚定不移的防御的象征。: A symbol of unity between unrelenting aggression and unwavering defense.

lines.永远的放逐者已无所畏惧。Kullervo 是反叛与抵御压迫的化身。: The eternal outcast has nothing left to fear. Kullervo embodies rebellion and the will to endure whatever the oppressor can dish out.
lines.沉思。母亲。女王。用这件 Titania 的替换头盔提振士气。: Muse. Mother. Queen. Rally your court with this alternate helm for Titania.

lines.没有什么比秘密更具破坏性的了。用这个 Equinox 的外观来释放你的另一面吧！: Few things are more destructive than a secret. Unleash your opposite with this skin for Equinox.
lines.没有什么比肩上野兽与感染者的融合更能让你敌人感到恐惧。: Nothing strikes fear into your enemies like the fusion of beast and Infestation draped upon your shoulder.

lines.洛德使用阿尔布雷希特实验室中的装置将赋能分解成荧尘，这是一种用于转换的强效粉末。: Loid uses devices in Albrecht's Laboratory to reduce Arcanes to Vosfor, a potent powder for alchemical processes. Speak to Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos to trade Vosfor for Arcanes he has stored in the laboratory.
lines.流动的装束让你在激烈战斗中的行动更自如。还包含 Hydroid 的踏浪长衣特殊配: Flowing finery that allows ease of movement in the heat of battle. Also includes the Burangara Longcoat auxiliary attachment for Hydroid.

lines.许多烦恼的梦都是在这床垫上做的。: Many troubled dreams were dreamed on this mattress.

lines.诸星碧是六人组的保卫者副官，她为 Mag 战甲带来了人性化的一面。使用内含的碧双: Aoi Morohoshi, the Hex's protective second-in-command, brings a human face to the Mag Warframe. Switch between Mag and Aoi's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Aoi Gemini Emote, even during missions.
lines.诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
lines.诺拉·夜脸上涂着节日彩绘的浮印。: A glyph of Nora Night wearing festive face paint.
lines.象征了 Grineer 双子女皇的腐化力量。: Symbolizing the corrupting power of the Grineer Queens.
lines.象征对奥布山谷上所有物种安全和保障的奉献精神。: A symbol of your dedication to the safety and security of all creatures on the Orb Vallis.
lines.象征对火卫二上所有物种安全的奉献精神。: A symbol of your dedication to the safety of all creatures on Deimos.
lines.象征着在所有 Tenno 体内潮汐起伏的能量。: A symbol of the energy that ebbs and flows through all Tenno.
lines.财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
lines.购买 TennoCon 2021 周边商品礼包的附赠物品。: Bonus item for purchasing the TennoCon 2021 Merch Pack.
lines.购买 TennoCon 2022 周边商品礼包的附赠物品。: Bonus item for purchasing the TennoCon 2022 Merch Pack.
lines.赋予任意一把长剑大师级的训练武器外观。漆木和金箔的表面下可能潜藏着锋利的剑刃。: Give any longsword the appearance of a masterwork training weapon. A surface of lacquered wood and gold leaf may conceal a hard-biting edge.
lines.赐予那些参与 TennoCon 2023 欢庆的玩家。: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2023.
lines.赠与 Tenno 以奖励他们在清巢行动徽章中做出的贡献。: Awarded to Tenno for the contributions they made during the Breeding Grounds event.
lines.赤毒是 Grineer 女皇梦寐以求的一种非常罕见的红色液体。它可以从赤毒任务中: Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be obtained in Kuva Missions, and is used to Cycle Rivens or build rare blueprints. Location: Kuva Siphon Missions and Taveuni (Kuva Fortress)
lines.赫利俄光锤的节庆外观。: A festive skin for the Heliocor.

lines.赫利俄斯的标准外观配置。: The standard issue skin for the Helios Sentinel.
lines.走进空灵歌曲的回声中。: Walk in the echo of an ethereal song.
lines.起身反抗 Tenno 吧。为了讨厌的 Grineer 而战 ！总得有人要当坏人的: Take up arms against the Tenno. Fight for the loathsome Grineer! Someone has to be the bad guy.

lines.踏上这款经久不衰的脚凳放松身心，就像阿尔布雷希特·英择谛所做的一样。: Relax, as Albrecht Entrati must have, with this timeless ottoman.
lines.踏入对手的领地，制定击败他们的战略。此模拟允许将敌人难度设置超出标准最大值 25: Step into your opponent's territory to devise a strategy for their defeat. This simulacrum allows enemy difficulty to be set 25 levels above the standard maximum.
lines.身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
lines.身着 Ki'Teer 的原创披饰炫耀你无可挑剔的品味。: Flaunt your impeccable taste in a Ki’Teer original syandana.
lines.身着这件 Corpus 斗篷于战场上行军。: March through the battlefield with this Corpus cloak.
lines.身着这件灵感来自丑角的淘气豪华外观，来在黑暗梦境中翩翩起舞。: Dance through dark dreams with this mischievous, Harlequin-inspired deluxe skin.
lines.轨道飞行器中的猛禽伴侣。: A bird of prey to accompany you aboard the Orbiter.
lines.轨道飞行器的警觉之眼。: A watchful eye for the Orbiter.
lines.轻快的舞蹈，让人想起绝灵骥轻盈的步伐，非常适合春节。可在军械库的携带装备轮盘选项: A sprightly dance reminiscent of the kaithe's ambling prance, suitable for the Lunar Renewal. Equip this emote using the Gear Wheel tab in your Arsenal.
lines.轻盈且又低调。血色面纱刺客的护甲。: Lightweight and unobtrusive. The armor of Red Veil assassins.
lines.轻盈的水晶编织出晶莹剔透的网。Gara Prime 的标志性幻纹。: Levitating crystals weave a web of luminous connections. Gara Prime’s signature ephemera.
lines.迅发电浆炮双蛇会激起战斗的热度。: Acceltra Caduceus turns up the heat of battle.
lines.迅发电浆炮的节庆外观: A festive skin for the Acceltra.
lines.迎风飘扬的绯红缎带唤起了对古老地球的战争风筝的记忆。: Windswept ribbons of crimson evoke the war-kites of ancient earth.
lines.运用 Volt 原型的标志性战锤外观使电火花飞溅起来。: Make sparks fly with Volt Proto’s signature hammer skin.
lines.这一奖项授予在非竞赛类别中创作出杰出角色扮演作品的个人。: This award is for a person who created an exceptional Cosplay in the non-competitive category.
lines.这一奖项旨在表彰制作工艺一流的角色扮演作品。: This award recognizes a Cosplay with primo workmanship.
lines.这一奖项旨在表彰在舞台上表现出色的角色扮演。: This award recognizes a Cosplay with an outstanding on-stage performance.
lines.这一奖项旨在表彰对材料的创造性使用和对角色扮演主题的诠释！: This award recognizes creative use of materials and interpretation of the Cosplay's subject matter!
lines.这一奖项旨在表彰由评委选出的整体表现突出的角色扮演作品。: This award recognizes a Cosplay chosen by judges as a strong overall entry.
lines.这一装置可用来破解奥罗金的加密。获取地点：通过龙钥开启过的奥罗金遗迹宝库（火卫二: This device is used to bypass Orokin encryptions. Location: Orokin Derelict Vaults on Deimos once opened with a Dragon Key
lines.这两姐妹从不失手。吉利安和莉莉安·基利安回来大展身手了！: These sisters don't miss. Jillian and Lillian Killian are back to kick ass!
lines.这个与安普长棍外观所搭配的坠饰能够给任何近战武器增添一丝优雅。: This matching sugatra for the Anpu Staff Skin will add a dash of elegance to any Melee Weapon.
lines.这个侍刃外观是对美好生活的赞歌。Excalibur 盲侠的标志性侍刃外观。: This Nikana skin is an ode to a beautiful life cut short. A signature Nikana skin for Excalibur Zato.
lines.这个即时用金属钥匙扣系列每盒有 100 个，一定能满足你的需求！: This assorted collection of KineBasik metal keychains comes in a case of 100 and is sure to meet your needs!
lines.这个古老的奥罗金弦乐器曾经属于一个伟大的禁卫。古老的民谣《朱兰笑》，是为这种乐器: This antique Orokin string instrument once belonged to a great Dax. The ancient ballad, 'Smiles from Juran,' is one of the few known examples of music composed for this instrument. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
lines.这个古老的雕纹曾经是一名远古 Tenno 在冥想仪式中的焦点。: This ancient glyph was the focus of an ancient Tenno meditation ritual.
lines.这个可爱版的六人组疲惫军医比她现实生活中更愿意接受拥抱。: This cuddly version of the Hex's weary medic is a lot more accepting of hugs than her real-life counterpart.
lines.这个可爱的有袋类动物在艰难时期象征着希望和同情心。: This lovable marsupial is a symbol of hope and compassion in trying times.
lines.这个坠饰曾作为装饰见于鬼怪传说中的武器上，然而其起源依然未知。: This Sugatra has been seen adorning the weapons of myths and monsters alike, its provenance unknown.
lines.这个头环的最高版本，标志着在《行动代号：八爪》中对内奇·鲁莎卡那虚假双衍王境的否: The supreme version of this signa, signifying the denial of Neci Rusalka's false Duviri in Operation: Eight Claw.
lines.这个头环致敬你在面对令人心神不宁的低语者时始终如一的坚定奉献。: This signa pays tribute to your steadfast dedication in the face of the mind-tormenting Murmur.
lines.这个展示图在致敬 Sirius，一颗孤独的星。他在阴影中成长，在尊严中成长。: This display honors Sirius, the lonely star. Raised in shadow. Trained with dignity.
lines.这个展示图既展现了两种文化的优点，也揭露了它们的缺点。无论团结还是分裂，它们都是: This display celebrates the best of both worlds, and the worst of each. United or divided, they are two sides of the same whole.
lines.这个展示图是为了纪念 Orion，他拥有一颗燃烧的心。他从小就被复仇所熏陶，他唯: This display honors Orion, the burning heart. Schooled in vengeance, the only love he knows is death.
lines.这个席瓦 & 神盾外观中散发出的火焰摇曳不定，仿佛它们希望去往别处。: The flames emanating from this skin for the Silva & Aegis waver uncertainly, as though they might wish to be elsewhere.
lines.这个徽章上的全息界面会随着你在战术警报中的楷模表现不断更新显示你所达到的级别。: The holographic interface on this emblem will update to display the rank achieved through exemplary dedication to Tactical Alerts.
lines.这个徽章用于奖励给参加第一次国服测试的先驱者们。: This emblem is awarded to participants of the Warframe Controlled Closed Beta.
lines.这个忠实的殁世械灵已经为英择谛家族服务了几个世纪。现在他已经准备好为你提供服务了: This faithful Necraloid has served the Entrati family for centuries. He now stands ready to offer his service to you.
lines.这个忧郁的小家伙会偷走你的心，因为他在你的轨道飞行器守护着你最珍贵的东西。: This broody little guy will steal your heart as he stands guard over your most precious things inside your Orbiter.
lines.这个护甲的厚度足以抵御寒风的侵袭。: This armor's thickness protects against the cold wind's bite.
lines.这个毛绒版忠诚的英择谛管家需要一些拥抱。: This fluffy version of Entrati's loyal butler is in need of some hugs.
lines.这个独特的展示图，展现了阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的两面。由社区艺术家 Shiro_k: A unique display, featuring two sides of Albrecht Entrati. Created by Community Artist Shiro_kosh_a.
lines.这个玩偶的每一针每一线中都注入了满满的爱。: A great deal of love went into every stitch of this floof.
lines.这个花瓶上的凹槽是由艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆精心塑造的。: The grooves in this vase were shaped by the careful hands of artist Bren Terrasiam.
lines.这个蛋是用来将库狛的遗传密码转移到库狛克隆体上。获取地点：Grineer 森林（: This egg is used to transplant the genetic code of a Kubrow onto a Kubrow clone. Location: Kubrow Dens found in Grineer Forests on Earth
lines.这个装置能让库狛克隆体或库娃克隆体从出生成长至幼年时期。: This device facilitates the growth of a Kubrow or Kavat clone, from birth to adolescence.
lines.这个轨道飞行器装饰记录了英择谛家族齐聚一堂的罕见时刻。: The Entrati family harmonize in a rare moment of unity in this Orbiter decoration.
lines.这个雕塑可为你的轨道飞行器注入库娃的优美和美妙之姿。: A sculpture to imbue your Orbiter with the grace and beauty of the Kavat.
lines.这个雕塑可为你的轨道飞行器注入库狛的庄严之力。: A sculpture to imbue your Orbiter with the regal strength of the Kubrow.
lines.这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
lines.这个骇人的血红库狛顿头骨作为战利品被制成了 Excalibur 盲侠的肩甲。这个: The skull of a monstrous Kubrodon Incarnadine was made into this, Excalibur Zato's prize shoulder plate. The story behind the taking of this particular trophy remains a mystery.
lines.这个魔典外观的封面沸腾翻滚，极尽所能地阻止任何人的触碰。: The seething cover of this skin for the Grimoire does all it can to disinvite touch.
lines.这些令人眼花缭乱的花卉形式能隐藏更深层的意涵。: This dazzling floral form can conceal darker intentions.
lines.这些优美的死亡弧线乃是受到了数种捕食性植物的启发。: These graceful arcs of death are inspired by several species of predatory plants.
lines.这些凝聚虚空能量的锋利之刃能造成了深切而痛苦的伤口。: These razor-sharp blades of condensed Void energy inflict deep and grievous wounds.
lines.这些利爪将于 Valkyr 解放她的狂化爆发力量时显现。: These talons emerge when Valkyr unleashes her Hysteria.
lines.这些复古动作太酷了。从科技细胞终幕者处获得。: These vintage moves are just too cool for school. Earned from a Technocyte Coda.
lines.这些威力强大的双持手枪的炫彩外观。: A radiant skin for these hard-hitting dual pistols.
lines.这些容器虽然号称能存放各类珍贵资源，实际上主要盛装着各种烈性酒。: While purported to house all manner of precious resources, in truth these containers primarily contained various strong drinks.
lines.这些常常用来装点仪式装束，或者被用来做合成的反应物。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）: These will often adorn ceremonial garb or as a reagent for synthetics. Source: Cut from Sharrac fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Sharrac in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
lines.这些怪异的烛光以难以察觉的方式悬浮着。: These eerie lights are suspended above the ground by no perceptible means.
lines.这些装饰性的护甲乃 Ki'Teer 的原创作品。: This decorative armored plate is a Ki'Teer original.
lines.这些迷人的肩饰将带来极致的震撼。: Take style to shocking extremes with these glamorous shoulder pieces.
lines.这些金色倒刺是 Garuda Prime 的标志性护甲。: These golden barbs are Garuda Prime’s signature armor.
lines.这件 Vauban Prime 的标志性披饰令人联想到远古时期的要塞设计。: Evoking fortress designs of the ancient past, this is Vauban Prime's signature Syandana.
lines.这件不羁的、像翅膀一样的弧形披饰，是为了搭配飞空 Prime 护甲而精心打造的。: The bold, wing-like arcs of this Syandana have been crafted to complement the Avia Prime armor.
lines.这件专属的坠饰上交错镶嵌着发光的翡翠。: This exclusive sugatra is crisscrossed with an inlay of glowing jade.
lines.这件乐器曾属于坚守者中一位深受喜爱的成员，她经常会弹奏它来鼓舞同伴。: This instrument belonged to a much-loved member of the Holdfasts, who would often cheer up her companions with it.
lines.这件从 Tau 的战场上缴获的披饰，饱经战火洗礼，它反映了战争的代价。: Reclaimed from the battlefields of Tau, this battle-worn syandana reflects the cost of war.
lines.这件优雅的披风是 Banshee Prime 的标志性披饰。: This graceful cape is the signature Syandana of Banshee Prime.
lines.这件华丽的披饰散发着鬼魅的幽光。: A spectral glow emanates from this ornate syandana.
lines.这件在阿尔特拉废墟深处发现的披饰，被认为是 Gauss 在突破敌人防线，果断结束: Found deep in the rubble at Altra, this Syandana is thought to have been worn by Gauss on the day he broke through enemy lines, decisively ending that bloody siege.
lines.这件坠饰中两只优雅相拥的鸟恭贺着新春的到来。: In this Sugatra, the graceful embrace of two birds is a symbolic expression of renewal.
lines.这件感染坠饰是一个被几丁质甲壳所包裹的良性细胞组织。: This Infested sugatra is a benign cellular growth self-protected by chitinous plates.
lines.这件战甲的表面覆盖有精美的青铜涂层。: This Rhino Warframe has been been laced with filaments of burnished bronze.
lines.这件披饰上的华丽坠饰代表了宁静的理想。: The ornate charms on this Syandana represent the ideal of serenity.
lines.这件披饰以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。: This syandana has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
lines.这件披饰是一种传统的 Tenno 服装，通常只有在 Tenno 的仪式上才会穿戴: The Syandana is a traditional Tenno garment. This variation was often worn during the Tenno Absolution Ceremony.
lines.这件披饰是在漂流的遗迹宝库中被发现，在奥罗金帝国灭亡之前是由神庙守卫所穿戴。: Discovered in the vaults of a drifting derelict, this Syandana was worn by Temple Guardians before the fall of the Orokin Empire
lines.这件披饰经常在节日庆典时的社交场合中穿戴。: Used for festive ceremonies, this Syandana was often worn during social gatherings.
lines.这件有机科技披饰与肩部贴合，勾勒出独特且又突出的轮廓。: This techno-organic syandana fits over the shoulder, producing a unique, spiked silhouette.
lines.这件朔月女神披饰被镶嵌上棱水晶细丝。: This Hecate Syandana has been threaded with filaments of prisma crystals.
lines.这件朴素的披饰是根据瑞圣途的孩子们曾穿戴过的样式设计而来的，那些孩子们组成了一支: This humble Syandana is modeled on those worn by the Children of Reshantur, who formed into a clan devoted to Nezha in defense of their home.
lines.这件涂装着液态棱晶的 Excalibur 战甲富含了纯净的虚空能量。: This Excalibur Warframe has been coated with liquid prisma, enriched by pure Void energy.
lines.这件由其他几位不那么走运的战甲的残骸所组装而成的独特头盔，被 Xaku 裁切出了: Xaku cuts a unique profile in this distinctive helmet assembled from the remains of several other, less fortunate Warframes.
lines.这件由备用的战备零件打造而成的斗篷可是 Grinneer 兵队中罕见的创造性的例: Fashioned with spare field components this cloak is an example of rarely seen creativity within the Grineer ranks.
lines.这件百人披饰装饰着令人感到酷热的设计。: A Centuria Syandana that has been adorned with a sizzling design.
lines.这件翼状般的披饰呼应着自谷神蝶雀的美丽与轻灵。: This wing-like syandana invokes the beauty and agility of the Ceresean Butterfly Sparrow.
lines.这件脉动着的装饰赞颂着你对武形秘仪的钟情。自豪地将之展示在你的飞船中。: This pulsating ornament is an ode to your dedication to The Conclave. Display it proudly in your ship.
lines.这件艺术品可以轻而易举地把那些运气不好的人撕成碎片。Garuda 的标志性武扇外: With a snap and a flutter this segmented work of art ribbons the hapless. The signature warfan skin of Garuda.
lines.这件英择谛精巧设计的细长金属臂，以一种完美平衡的状态，托举着一团微妙的蓝色火焰。: This delicate Entrati design’s slender metal arm holds a subtle blue flame in a state of perfect equipoise.
lines.这件虹彩的坠饰会吸引所有人的目光。: Every eye will be drawn to this iridescent sugatra.
lines.这件装饰表彰了氏族为道场社区发展所作的贡献。: A decoration to recognize the contributions of a Clan to the broader Dojo Community.
lines.这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻催眠中醒来。: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo statis.
lines.这具装饰性护甲是为了 Grineer 女皇的忠心库娃所铸造。: This decorative armor was forged for the Grineer Queens’ royal Kavats.
lines.这副弓箭外观被困在其中的亡魂所萦绕，渴求着制造更多亡魂。: This bow skin is haunted by the spirits of the dead trapped within, and hungers to create more.
lines.这副面具与一个被人所遗忘年代的古老传说息息相关。: This mask is tied to an ancient legend from a forgotten era.
lines.这只古墓头盔赋予你的 Nekros 战甲一个恐怖的面貌。: The Raknis helmet provides a terrifying visage for your Nekros Warframe.
lines.这只库狛喜欢用玛戈夏至披饰擦干身体。哪只库狛不喜欢玩水呢？: This Kubrow dries off with a Maggor Towsun Syandana. What Kubrow doesn’t love the water?
lines.这只库阿卡非常感谢你为慈善事业收养了它！: This Kuaka is so grateful you adopted it for charity!
lines.这只弗鸣克非常感谢你为慈善事业收养了它！: This Virmink is so grateful you adopted it for charity!
lines.这只梭歌非常感谢你为慈善事业收养了它！: This Sawgaw is so grateful you adopted it for charity!
lines.这台机器由阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计和制造，其确切用途与他本人一样是个谜。: Designed and built by Albrecht Entrati, the precise purpose of this machine is as much of an enigma as the man himself.
lines.这套 Rhino 战甲以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。: This Rhino Warframe has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
lines.这套库狛护甲据传是由创作出螺钉步枪的 Tenno 武器匠铸造的。: This Kubrow armor is believed to have been forged by the same Tenno weaponsmith who created the Boltor.
lines.这套护甲的太阳光辉让朋友和敌人都为之眩目。: Dazzle friends and enemies alike, with this armor’s solar brilliance.
lines.这套护甲的设计风格跟苍鹰冲锋枪及鹤鸵长戟相配，赋予任何 Tenno 一股威严感。: Styled to match the Baza submachine gun and the Cassowar polearm, this armor gives a regal look to any Tenno.
lines.这套护甲莫名其妙地让敌人与配戴者都感到一种强烈的不安。: For no discernable reason, this armor produces a distinct feeling of unease in enemies, as well as the wearer.
lines.这套特别的护甲由残骸拼接打造而成，是钢铁防线 Grineer 反叛者的标志性护甲: Pieced together from salvage, this ad hoc armor set is signature to the Grineer renegades of Steel Meridian.
lines.这套身经百战的西格玛系列护甲是远古之战中公认的航道星舰舰员战斗着装。: The hardened Sigma Series Armor was recognized battle dress for Old War Railjack crews.
lines.这套金饰护甲将荣耀带给了那些被遗忘已久的战斗大师。: This golden decorative armor honors master warriors long since forgotten.
lines.这套骄傲的护甲彰显着穿戴者在战场上的英勇。: This proud panoply declares the wearer's bravery on the field of battle.
lines.这如烈焰般绚烂的坠饰，足以将轻率之人引入迷途。: The entrancing light of this fiery sugatra will lead the unwary astray.
lines.这对双子蝰蛇以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。: These Twin Vipers have been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
lines.这尊雕像之所以被打造出来，不仅是为了纪念英择谛家族的实力与威望，同时也是为了保存: Struck to commemorate the Entrati family’s power and prestige, as well as safeguarding their memories of one another. Many things changed in the years that followed, and that which had once shone brightly grew dark and dim. But even a single Ayatan Star may make all the difference.
lines.这尊雕像用以纪念乌尔佛伦的力量。: Display this statue in honor of Ulfrun's strength.
lines.这尊雕像用以纪念亚克什的凶猛。: Display this statue in honor of Raksh's ferocity.
lines.这尊雕像用以纪念戴拿的警觉。: Display this statue in honor of Dynar's vigilance.
lines.这尊雕像用以纪念莱卡斯的狩猎。: Display this statue in honor of Lycath's hunt.
lines.这带有金色尖刺的头环以苦难铸就瑰丽。: This crowning signa of gilded spikes creates beauty out of suffering.
lines.这幅壁画循环展示了四张曾经守护月球的狼群的优雅肖像：暗影者戴拿、防御者亚克什、顽: This mural cycles through four elegant portraits of the wolves that once guarded Lua: Dynar the shadowed, Raksh the defender, Lycath the stalwart, and Ulfrun the fierce.
lines.这座冒着烟的 H-09 炽蛇军王者坦克炮台将装饰你的登陆艇。: The smoldering turret of an H-09 Apex Scaldra tank shall adorn your Landing Craft.
lines.这张海报是对《内战》的致敬。由 Kevin Glint 完成艺术创作。: This poster is a tribute to The War Within. Art created by Kevin Glint.
lines.这张海报是对《新纪之战》的致敬。由 Kevin Glint 完成艺术创作。: This poster is a tribute to The New War. Art created by Kevin Glint.
lines.这张海报是对《牺牲》的致敬。由 Kevin Glint 完成艺术创作。: This poster is a tribute to The Sacrifice. Art created by Kevin Glint.
lines.这张海报是对《第二场梦》的致敬。由 Kevin Glint 完成艺术创作。: This poster is a tribute to The Second Dream. Art created by Kevin Glint.
lines.这恶性生长之物可以优雅地披挂于任何 Tenno 的肩膀。: This malignant growth hangs elegantly on the shoulders of any Tenno.
lines.这把加拉丁暗影的表面覆盖有精美的鎏金涂层。: This Galatine has been been laced with filaments of burnished bronze.
lines.这把威严的长柄武器是由中枢设计的，可以自发干预敌人的敌对行动。: This commanding Cephalon-designed polearm is just the thing for spontaneously interrupting an enemy's hostile processes.
lines.这把庄严的战刃曾经一位强大禁卫值得信赖的战斗工具。: This imposing glaive was once the trusted battle tool of a mighty Dax.
lines.这把蝰蛇以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。: This Viper has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
lines.这把迦伦提恩以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。: This Galatine has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
lines.这把龙息匣炮的表面覆盖有精美的鎏金涂层。: This Drakgoon has been been laced with filaments of burnished bronze.
lines.这把龙骑兵装饰着一层美丽的红化结晶电镀。: This Drakgoon has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
lines.这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份十三周年纪: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the thirteenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
lines.这是 Ordis 为从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份周年纪念欢庆护甲: A celebratory armor set presented by Ordis to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno awakening from Cryo stasis.
lines.这是一个由一些未被识别的机械内部残骸组装而成的披饰，它依然沾染着从它被发现之地带: A syandana assembled from the scavenged internals of some unidentified mechanism, it is still dusty from the desert where it was found.
lines.这是一枚荣誉勋章，献给真正的真理追寻者。来自另一个时空，另一个世界……: A badge of honor befitting one of the genuine truth-seekers. From another time, in another world...
lines.这是基座制造的巅峰产物。伴随着其发光的装饰和波浪状的支脚，这款基座是如此独特，以: Here it is: the pinnacle of pedestal production. With its luminescent accents and undulating legs, this is a stand so unique it renders all other plinths prosaic. You can search a lifetime, but you’ll never find another piece quite like the Umbral Pedestal.
lines.这是底线，因为库狛是这么说的。: That's the bottom line 'cause Kubrow said so.
lines.这是曾经用来在 Tau 上区分禁卫指挥官的披饰；现在佩戴它是一种荣耀的象征。: A syandana once worn to distinguish Dax commanders on Tau; wear it now as a mark of pride.
lines.这是此幻纹的巅峰版本，象征着在《行动代号：兽之腹》中战胜帕尔沃斯·格拉努的军队。: The pinnacle version of this ephemera, signifying victory over Parvos Granum’s forces in Operation Belly of the Beast.
lines.这是贝克兰·扎夫特在她目睹 Lavos 对哲士哈维的遗体进行转化时，拿着拖把和水: A replica of the very mop and bucket Bekran Zaft was holding when she witnessed the transmutation of the remains of Archimedean Javi by Lavos. As detailed by Drusus Leverian.
lines.这是驾驶航道星舰穿越钢铁之路的标志。: A signifier of piloting the Railjack through the Steel Path.
lines.这条丝质的光滑丝带上点缀着一粒星辰。: A flowing ribbon of silken fabric, crowned with a star.
lines.这条坠饰以呼应古代海船扬帆的形式，为任何武器营造出领航者的轮廓。: With a form that echos the sails of ancient sea ships, this sugatra creates a commanding silhouette on any weapon.
lines.这条坠饰受到了参与武形秘仪的 Tenno 喜爱，因为它是团结与信念的象征。: This sugatra is favoured by Tenno participating in the Conclave, as it is a symbol of unity and conviction.
lines.这条獒犬既能承受打击，也能造成大量伤害。: This mastiff can take it, and dish it out.
lines.这条长而有力的缎带标志着 Tenno 的平衡之道。: This long, powerful ribbon symbolizes the Tenno path toward balance.
lines.这枚传统纹章代表着 Tenno 中精通段位的巅峰。: This legacy sigil represents the pinnacle of mastery within the Tenno.
lines.这枚奖章奖励给在「和平者之叛」活动中证明自己的 Tenno。: An insignia awarded to the Tenno who proved themselves during the Pacifism Defect operation.
lines.这枚徽章代表着佩戴者是 Tenno 中的大宗师阶级。: This emblem signifies the wearer as being a Grand Master within the Tenno ranks.
lines.这枚徽章代表着佩戴者是 Tenno 中的大师阶级。: This emblem signifies the wearer as being a Master within the Tenno ranks.
lines.这枚徽章代表着佩戴者是 Tenno 中的巡猎者阶级。: This emblem signifies the wearer as being a Hunter within the Tenno ranks.
lines.这枚徽章代表着佩戴者是 Tenno 中的门徒阶级。: This emblem signifies the wearer as being a Disciple within the Tenno ranks.
lines.这枚徽章奖赏给在 Tohtchi 变体中证明自己的 Tenno 精英。: An insignia awarded to the Tenno Elite who proved themselves during the Tohtchi Variant.
lines.这枚徽章是奖励给参与国服公测的天诺战士。: This emblem is awarded to the most dedicated of Tenno during the Warframe Open Beta.
lines.这枚徽章是颁发给成功打击破坏了泰尔·雷工的克隆实验室的 Tenno。: An emblem awarded the Tenno who fought to destroy Tyl Regor's cloning labs.
lines.这枚徽章被授予给那些在机弦行动中证明了自己实力的 Tenno 精英。: An insignia awarded to the Tenno Elite who proved themselves during Operation Sling-Stone.
lines.这枚特殊的纹章以能极高度自定的棱晶渐变色彩为其特色。: This exclusive sigil features prisma color gradients for maximum customization.
lines.这枚独特的纹章描绘着一只地球远古时期的神秘生物。: This is a unique sigil depicting a mysterious creature of ancient Earth.
lines.这枚纹章不会轻易被抹去。: This sigil won't just buff out.
lines.这枚纹章了绘制了一个神秘闪烁着的部落设计。: This sigil depicts a tribal design that flickers mysteriously.
lines.这枚纹章代表着 Tenno 中精通段位的巅峰。: This sigil represents the pinacle of mastery within the Tenno.
lines.这枚纹章代表着你的库娃对你的忠诚。: A sigil representing your Kavat allegiance.
lines.这枚纹章代表着你的库狛对你的忠诚。: A sigil representing your Kubrow allegiance.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了 Ostron 的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Ostron.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了中枢苏达的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Cephalon Suda.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了佩兰数列的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Perrin Sequence.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了六人组的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with The Hex.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了均衡仲裁者的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Arbiters of Hexis.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了坚守者的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Holdfasts.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了夜羽的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Quills.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了新世间的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the New Loka.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了武形秘仪的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Conclave.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了殁世械灵的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Necraloid.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了科维兽的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Cavia.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了索拉里斯之声的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Vox Solaris.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了索拉里斯联盟的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Solaris United.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了英择谛的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Entrati.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了血色面纱的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Red Veil.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了通风小子的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Ventkids.
lines.这枚纹章代表着得到了钢铁防线的威望。: A sigil representing prestige gained with the Steel Meridian.
lines.这枚纹章就像一个神秘的字形: This sigil resembles a mysterious glyph.
lines.这枚纹章属于其中一位创始 Tenno 大宗师。: This sigil belongs to one of the founding grand masters of the Tenno.
lines.这枚纹章属于其中一位创始 Tenno 大师。: This sigil belongs to one of the founding masters of the Tenno.
lines.这枚纹章属于其中一位创始 Tenno 猎人。: This sigil belongs to one of the founding hunters of the Tenno.
lines.这枚纹章属于其中一位创始 Tenno 的门徒。: This sigil belongs to one of the founding disciples of the Tenno.
lines.这枚纹章是由氏族内团结一致的成员所配戴。: This sigil is worn by the members united within a Clan.
lines.这枚纹章是由联盟内团结一致的成员所配戴。: This sigil is worn by the members united within an Alliance.
lines.这枚纹章燃烧时会发出冰之火焰。: This sigil burns with a cold flame.
lines.这枚纹章纪念 Tenno 战胜了奈富·安尤的阴谋。: This sigil commemorates the Tenno victory over the machinations of Nef Anyo.
lines.这枚纹章镶有来自虚空的能量。: This sigil is laced with energy from the Void.
lines.这架虫型的登陆艇装置了治愈塔，可支援空中作战。: This insect-like landing craft features Med-Tower air-support.
lines.这款 Ki'Teer 原创的头环，是他最耀眼的藏品。: This signa is a Ki'Teer original, the crowning glory of any collection.
lines.这款 Prime 护甲的弧形线条令人忆起海上的船只: The swooping lines of this prime armor evoke a ship at sea.
lines.这款 Sevagoth 的标志性手枪外观完美平衡了光明与黑暗，优雅与死亡。: This skin for Sevagoth’s signature pistol balances light and darkness, beauty and death.
lines.这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
lines.这款优雅的军官武器由维克多·维德诺伊中尉委托制造供其个人使用，融合了太阳神和月神: Commissioned by Lieutenant Viktor Vodyanoi for his personal use, this elegant officer's weapon incorporates Sol and Lua motifs.
lines.这款光滑的增幅器外观堪称工艺杰作。: This sleek amp skin is a masterstroke of craftsmanship.
lines.这款冥想珠串坠饰是 Excalibur 盲侠的标志性饰物。: This meditation-bead Sugatra is a signature adornment of Excalibur Zato.
lines.这款冬季外观与布洛卡披饰的几何图案完美契合。: This winter rendering is a perfect fit for the geometric patterns of the Broca syandana.
lines.这款凯洛斯特外观上印有早已被世人遗忘的刺客组织火山石的标志。: This Karyst skin bears the markings of a long forgotten assassin's order, the Scoria.
lines.这款华丽曼妙的披饰，不仅能让听众折服，与那位演奏曼达和弦琴的女音乐家更是绝配。: Awe the crowds with this majestic flourish of a Syandana, fit for the mistress of the Mandachord.
lines.这款即时灵！派对灯还可在紧急情况下充当探照灯！: This KineMagik! kicking party light also doubles as a search light in instances of duress!

lines.这种厚壳被 Ostron 人用来制作工具和武器。获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔: This thick shell is used by Ostrons to manufacture tools and weapons. Source: Cut from Glappid fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Glappid in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at Night using Glappid Bait. Also drops from Thumper Bulls in the Plains of Eidolon.

lines.造访瓦奇娅来使用阿耶精华和御品阿耶精华交易专属装备。: See Varzia to trade Aya and Regal Aya for exclusive Gear.
lines.遵循一个罕见的奥罗金设计来制作的达曼坠饰能展现出使用者的武术技巧与技术。: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Daman Sugatra follows a rare Orokin design.
lines.避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
lines.邀请一只 Nidus Prime 的镀金蛆虫在你的轨道飞行器中漫游。: Invite one of Nidus Prime's gilded maggots to roam your Orbiter.
lines.邀请异世界的灵魂进入你的轨道飞行器。: Invite the spirits of the Otherworld into your Orbiter.
lines.那些响应总司令罗瑟号召的人们佩戴的奖章。: A medallion worn by those who rallied to the banner of Grand Carnus Roathe.
lines.那些在不同环境中战斗的人喜欢这款连帽头盔的多功能性。: Those who fight in varied environments appreciate the versatility of this hooded helmet.
lines.那些感受过 Voruna 梅迪娜标志性的重型巨刃凶猛攻击的人，就会明白为什么它的: Those who feel the vicious bite of Voruna Medeina’s signature heavy blade skin know why its wielder has no need for subtlety.
lines.那些称清晨迷雾和战争烟云为家的人的首选护甲套装。这是对积云披饰的一个完美补充。: The preferred armor set of those who call both the mists of morning and the fog of war home. A perfect complement to the the Cumulus Syandana.
lines.那些过着高尚生活的人背负着镀金伤疤所带来的荣耀。: Those who lead a noble life bear the honor of gilded scars.
lines.那破碎的美丽，慢步在充满光影、斑斓和利刃的舞台上。: Walk in fractured beauty amid a dance of light, color, and razor edges.
lines.配备这款充满好运气息的近战武器饰物，共贺农历新春。: A weapon decoration in the form of two circling carp.
lines.采用你的 Corpus 敌人的审美。让他们看看谁的未来愿景将得胜。: Adopt your Corpus enemy’s aesthetic. Show them whose vision of the future will prevail.
lines.释放你内心的野性。: Bring forth the look of your inner beast.
lines.释放的魅影粒子形成一种惰性粉尘，可以收集起来为各种机器人项目重新充能。获取地点：: Discharged specter particles form an inert dust that can be collected and re-energized for various robotic projects. Location: Errant Specters in the Granum Void (Corpus Ship Tileset)
lines.重击巨锤的次世代外观。: A next-generation skin for the Fragor.
lines.重新设计的准军事服装，以快速应对任何情况。: Repurposed paramilitary dress, for a fast response to any situation.
lines.重温与玛丽约会的美好回忆。: Relive the memory of a date with Marie.
lines.野兽或许可以穿着华服，但永远不会被驯服。Voruna Prime 的标志性幻纹。: The beast may be adorned, but never tamed. Voruna Prime's signature ephemera.
lines.量子切割器的次世代外观。: A next-generation skin for the Quanta.
lines.金·柯基总统对你为阻止安娜·基和混沌起源的不懈努力表示认可。: President King Corgi acknowledges your unending dedication to thwarting Anna Ki and the G.O.B.
lines.金属物质，被 Helminth 的消化液不断腐蚀，并以大颗粒粉尘的形式分泌了出来: Metallic substances, steadily corroded by the Helminth's digestive juices and exuded as a coarse powder.
lines.钙化的肉体创造出了怪异的美感。: Calcified flesh creates forms of grotesque beauty.
lines.钢铁防线的浮印: A glyph of the Steel Meridian
lines.钢铁防线集团的勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。: Medallion of the Steel Meridian syndicate. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
lines.铭记 Vauban 的传承的浮印。: A glyph that immortalizes Vauban’s legacy.
lines.铭记那些违抗 Tenno 之道的人。: Never forget those who would defile the Tenno ways.
lines.锡斯特双枪的闪电迷彩外观。: The Shock-Camo skin for the Dual Cestra.
lines.锡斯特的闪电迷彩外观。: The Shock-Camo skin for the Cestra.
lines.锤落筒转，周而复始。无瑕的机械在依序运转。: The hammer falls, the cylinder turns, and the cycle begins once again. Flawless machinery moving in sequence.
lines.锯齿状的结晶矿。放出辐射能量。获取地点：地球，月球，火卫一，欧罗巴，冥王星，赛德: A jagged crystalline ore. Gives off radiant energy. Location: Earth, Lua, Phobos, Europa, Pluto, Sedna, and the Void
lines.镀金美食家 Grendel Prime 的标志性披饰。: The signature Syandana of the gilded gourmand, Grendel Prime.
lines.长于地球森林中的一种小蕨类植物。: A small fern found in the forests of Earth.
lines.闪耀着电镀水晶的光芒，Gyre Prime 的标志性护甲散发着优雅的火花。: Gleaming with galvanic crystals, Gyre Prime's signature armor crackles with elegance.
lines.阈限者的战衣; 中庸之道的新样式。: War-garb for the liminal; a new form for the in-between.
lines.阴影守护的精灵外观。: The Sprite skin customization for the Shade Sentinel.
lines.阴影的标准外观配置。: The standard issue skin for the Shade Sentinel.
lines.阿尔布雷希特·英择谛用此绘制通向未知时代的时间路径。: Used by Albrecht Entrati to chart a temporal path to eras unknown.
lines.阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的帽子的浮印，由 SirEnarion 创作。: A glyph depicting the hat of Albrecht Entrati, designed by SirEnarion.
lines.阿尔布雷希特·英择谛自己设计的一把另类椅子。: An unorthodox chair of Albrecht Entrati’s own design.
lines.阿尔布雷希特已经拍板了。抛售它。由社区艺术家 ibumuc 创作。: Albrecht is making the call. Dump it. Created by Community artist ibumuc.
lines.阿尔布雷希特正在阅读节庆魔典的浮印，由 Cyanfacade 创作。: A Glyph depicting Albrecht reading a festive Grimoire, created by Cyanfacade.
lines.阿提卡的次世代外观。: A next-generation skin for the Attica.
lines.阿特拉克斯使用的沙漠伪装外观。: Desert camouflage skin for the Atterax.
lines.阿米尔·贝克特是六人组中的古怪而乐观的技术员，他为 Volt 战甲带来了人性化的: Amir Beckett, the Hex's quirky, upbeat technician, brings a human face to the Volt Warframe. Switch between Volt and Amir's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Amir Gemini Emote, even during missions.
lines.附肢寄生者的独特外观。: A unique skin for the Paracyst.
lines.附近的双衍王境奥理将标注为标记点。: Nearby Duviri Enigmas will be marked with a waypoint.
lines.降低结合扫描器扫描目标所需的时间。: Reduces the time required to scan a target with the Synthesis Scanner.
lines.陨蜓 Prime 曲翼的默认外观。: Default skin for the Odonata Prime Archwing.
lines.陨蜓曲翼的独特外观。: A unique skin for the Odonata Archwing.
lines.陨蜓曲翼的默认外观。: Default skin for the Odonata Archwing.
lines.随性飘逸的发型，呈现经典的 90 年代 Emo 风格。: Floppy locks, for a classic 90s Emo look.
lines.随着奥罗金的覆灭，Yareli 盘古底漂流到海洋的深处，在那里被 Hunhow: With the fall of the Orokin, Yareli Pandea drifted into the ocean's depths where Hunhow rediscovered her. Now, she ascends to fight once more.
lines.随着时间的推移形成了简朴的结晶美，看似脆弱却又尖锐致命。地层披饰完美地装点了岩溶: Austere crystalline beauty, formed over time, deceptively delicate, lethally sharp. The Stratum Syandana perfectly compliments Karst, Atlas' deluxe skin.
lines.随着每击倒一位敌人，终极披饰的光芒将愈加闪耀。: With every enemy struck down the Telos Syandana glows stronger.
lines.随着轻盈的脚步踏出能够修补天空的五色石。: Step lightly with stones that could mend the very fabric of the heavens.
lines.隐士绯红披饰会在每次的暗杀燃起火焰，并且愈燃愈亮。: This Asita Rakta Syandana ignites a jet of flames that burns brighter with each stealth takedown.
lines.难以抑制的 Revenant 能量的载体。: A mere vessel of uncontainable Revenant energy.
lines.集美丽与珍奇为一身的独特卷须室内植物。: Beauty and strangeness blend in this distinctive tendrilled houseplant.
lines.雷克斯的精英外观。: An elite skin for the Lex.
lines.雷霆的节庆外观。: A festive skin for the Fulmin.
lines.霍姆巴斯的材质结构充满了「扎里曼号」探索、创新和友爱的精神。材质结构为虚空之壳外: Hombask's material structures are imbued with the Zariman spirit of discovery and innovation. Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
lines.霍瓦尼亚中央商场的卡娅·维拉斯科收取这些贴纸芯片，提供易撕贴纸包。获取地点：精英: Kaya Velasco in the Höllvania Mall accepts these Pix Chips in exchange for Peely Paks. Location: Elite Temporal Archimedea (Höllvania) and duplicate Peely Pix.
lines.霓虹灯条照亮了这款时尚的原子摩托车外观涂装。: Strips of neon illuminate this sleek Atomicycle livery.
lines.青绿色的玻璃悬挂在手工制作的镀金篮子中，注有生物冷光物质。: Turquoise glass suspended in a handmade gilded basket, filled with bioluminescence.
lines.非常适合欣赏蓬蓬士君的表演。有缓冲，以避免久坐的麻木不适。: Ideal for appreciating Bombastine’s performances. Cushioned to avoid uncomfortable posterior numbness.
lines.非晶态的固体。可能是奥罗金技术。获取地点：水星，火星，火卫一，欧罗巴和冥王星: An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology. Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto
lines.鞘翅曲翼的默认外观。: Default skin for the Elytron Archwing.
lines.顽强的兄弟——莱卡斯的优雅肖像。: An elegant portrait of Lycath, the stalwart brother.
lines.颁发徽章给在周末生存事件中证明自己的Tenno。: An insignia awarded to the Tenno who proved themselves during Survival event.
lines.颁发给参与异融者侵入活动的 Tenno。: Awarded to Tenno who participated in the Mutalist Incursions event.
lines.颁发给在沙漠恐惧事件中证明自己的 Tenno。: An insignia awarded to the Tenno who proved themselves during Arid Fear event.
lines.颁发给挺身对抗 Kela De Thaym 与旗下行刑者之人的奖章。: Awarded to those who stood against Kela De Thaym and her Executioners.
lines.颁发给那些非常致力于摧毁传送门行动中付出努力的Tenno。: Awarded to Tenno for their contribution during Operation Gate Crash.
lines.颁赠给参予了异融者入侵事件的 Tenno。: Awarded to Tenno who participated in the Mutalist Incursions event.
lines.领养 Nokko 的一只可爱菌宝，让它在轨道飞行器周围蹦蹦跳跳。: Adopt one of Nokko’s adorable Sprodlings to bounce around the orbiter.
lines.风吹动着这件翼状披饰，就像它吹动着所有参加征服癌症活动的人一样。: The wind uplifts this winglike syandana, as it does all who partake in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
lines.飘姿秀逸、淌若鲜血。一款可防渍的非对称披饰: Flows like grace. Flows like blood. An asymmetrical, stain-resistant Syandana.
lines.马谢特砍刀的替换外观，灵感来自于农历新春。: A spectacular alternative skin for the Machete, inspired by the Lunar Renewal.
lines.驾驶 Wyrm 在一场激烈的横向卷轴战斗中对抗 Corpus。: Pilot Wyrm in a hectic, side-scrolling battle against the Corpus.
lines.骨棘马尾上裸露的骨头提醒着人们珍惜生命的馈赠。: Bones laid bare in the Aebolg Tail are a reminder to appreciate the gift of life.
lines.骨骸寡妇殁世机甲的标准外观配置。: The standard issue skin for the Bonewidow Necramech.
lines.骨骸寡妇殁世机甲的标准头盔。: The standard issue helmet for the Bonewidow Necramech.
lines.高速疾行，必会留下痕迹。Gauss 摩托的标志性纹章。: High speed movement can leave its mark. Gauss Moto's signature sigil.
lines.高高踢起！当与最多四名氏族成员一起使用时，每个成员都会做出一个独特的动作，然后一: Kick it up high! When used together with up to four clanmates, each will perform a unique move before joining together in a final pose.
lines.鱼鹰的浮印: A glyph of a Corpus Osprey
lines.鲁莎卡少校独特的炽蛇军帽，在一次神秘通信中获得。: Neci Rusalka’s distinctive Scaldra hat, received as part of a mysterious communication.
lines.鲁莎卡少校的美丽秀发，被精心编织起来，以免缠住她的机械臂。: Major Rusalka's splendid hair, carefully plaited to keep it from entangling in her mechanical arm.
lines.鲜明的红色和白色釉彩闪亮在坚硬的陶瓷手鼓外观表面。: A bold red and white glaze glisten across the surface of this hardened ceramic Pandero skin.
lines.鲜花盛开，兔子蹦蹦跳跳，展现四季如春的欢乐。: Manifest the joys of blossoming flowers and hopping rablits in any season.
lines.鹤鸵长戟的次世代外观。: A next-generation skin for the Cassowar.
lines.鹦鹉螺 Prime 的标准外观配置。: The standard issue skin for the Nautilus Prime Sentinel.
lines.鹦鹉螺守护的标准外观配置。: The standard issue skin for the Nautilus Sentinel.
lines.麦格努斯双枪的次世代外观。: A next-generation skin for the Akmagnus.
lines.麦格努斯双枪的武器设计优胜者外观，由 MaaYuu 设计。: A prize-winning skin for the Akmagnus, designed by MaaYuu.
lines.麦格努斯双枪的武器设计优胜者外观，由 Verifitas 设计。: A prize-winning skin for the Akmagnus, designed by Verifitas.
lines.麦格努斯的次世代外观: A next-generation skin for the Magnus.
lines.麦格努斯的武器设计优胜者外观，由 MaaYuu 设计。: A prize-winning skin for the Magnus, designed by MaaYuu.
lines.麦格努斯的武器设计优胜者外观，由 Verifitas 设计。: A prize-winning skin for the Magnus, designed by Verifitas.
lines.黄金在某些研究领域有助于导电，但在这里纯属装饰用途。: Gold assists with conductivity in some areas of study, but here is purely decorative.
lines.黑白色的胡子月浮印，由社区艺术家 UpsideDownSmore 创作。: A Movember Glyph in black and white, created by Community artist UpsideDownSmore.
lines.龙之侍刃会因为装备上双子刀鞘而燃起炙烈的火光。: Dragon Nikana causes the Gemini Sheath to rage with molten fury.
lines.龙腾九天，承载千古智慧。: The dragon soars with the wisdom of the ages.
lines.龙辰的节庆外观: A festive skin for the Tatsu.
lines.（英文：ARQUEBEX）英择谛武器设计的巅峰之作：双能追击炮的毁灭威力之大，使: The pinnacle of Entrati weapons design: dual energy mortars that fire with such devastating power that the Necramech must first be locked into a braced, stationary turret mode.
lines.（英文：DESERT WIND PRIME）Baruuk Prime 把沙漠之风: Baruuk Prime channels the Desert Wind to turn his fists and feet into an exalted prime weapon.
lines.（英文：DESERT WIND）Baruuk 把沙漠之风转移到他的双拳和脚掌，使: Baruuk channels the desert wind to turn his fists and feet into an exalted weapon.
lines.（英文：DEX PIXIA）通过剃刀之翼翱翔天际并召唤这对强劲的手枪。: Take flight with Razorwing and summon these mighty dual pistols.
lines.（英文：DIWATA）通过剃刀之翼翱翔天际并召唤这把强大的巨刃。: Take flight with Razorwing and summon this formidable heavy blade.
lines.（英文：GLORY）释放翠玉之光的力量。: Unleash the power of the Jade Light.
lines.（英文：IRONBRIDE）一把灵感源自最古老刀剑的巨大利刃，这把武器是为了一次: A titanic blade modeled after some of the very oldest swords, this weapon was designed to slice through massed enemy troops in a single stroke.
lines.（英文：NOCTUA）掌握 Dante 编年史的力量。为夜枭安装典籍 Mod 以: Wield the power of Dante's chronicles. Customize Noctua with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Primary attack releases pages that tear into lethal pieces on hits. Its alternate attack releases a wave with infinite Punch Through.
lines.（英文：PARALLAX）星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.
